entries.title: Flower setup and settings
entries.summary: Shared setup/settings serve both Flower carriers. Unconfigured profiles offer setup; configured new chats offer editable starters without launching. Retained modal preserves saves/errors and makes covered chat inert without read acknowledgement; existing model/permission/recovery owns policy.

entries.title: Flower provider configuration
entries.summary: Desktop, Flower and Env share one dialog. Hosts own persistence. Choose a brand, connect, then select models. Preserve navigation, focus and recovery actions after connection failures; reject stale responses. Kimi shares one brand while access methods retain separate credentials and models.

entries.title: Flower ChatGPT authentication
entries.summary: Shared provider dialog owns account selection/auth feedback. Verified signed-in accounts differ from saved connections; sign-out retains compact stable summary. Explicit removal forgets only a signed-out local registration; host alone owns admission and protected persistence.

entries.title: Flower failure recovery
entries.summary: Floret owns outcomes/checkpoints/migration. Flower retains readable content and one recovery surface while drafts, queue edits, Stop/navigation remain usable. Transport uncertainty permits no replay. Readiness timeout offers refresh; deterministic migration failure remains administrative.

entries.title: Flower composer attachments
entries.summary: One Flower controller owns attachment select/paste/drop/retry/remove/preview/send. Hosts authenticate staging; Redeven owns bytes/unadmitted commands, Floret admitted history. Large text converts only after successful staging, retaining IME and source on failure.

entries.title: Flower file activity presentation
entries.summary: Typed canonical Floret Activity owns confirmed file effects; provisional argument counts belong to progress. Rows show filename/add-delete totals and exact unified diff, never private protocol paths. History grants no read authority; missing facts yield purpose/status, not invented diff.

entries.title: Flower consecutive tool sequences
entries.summary: Desktop/Env App group consecutive tools and adjacent thinking. Active groups open; following prose or canonical turn end folds eligible work, never temporary gaps. Inspection survives and answered input separates settled work. Presentation stays ephemeral over Floret facts without summaries or migrations.

entries.title: Flower activity disclosure interaction
entries.summary: Desktop and Env App render canonical Floret facts with one transcript viewport owner. Live updates cannot move pressed triggers or insert hit targets before click completion. Canceled gestures activate nothing; disposal releases gesture ownership while retained content stays inspectable.

entries.title: Flower conversation sidebar
entries.summary: Desktop and Env App share one Flower sidebar with ThreadID-owned rows and endpoint-owned pin order. Selection, running work, unread attention and pending actions remain distinct. Live summaries preserve row/menu/focus identity. Resizing and pin feedback are ephemeral presentation over the canonical ThreadCache.

entries.title: Flower inline media
entries.summary: Shared Flower renders canonical images/video/audio/screenshots/self-contained HTML through released Floe media/isolation. Redeven authorizes resources. Forbidden, missing, oversized or mismatched media yields local retryable errors without interrupting conversation.

entries.title: Flower explicit long-thread qualification
entries.summary: Complete conversations and responsive interaction are required. Run fixed-budget long-thread checks explicitly for acceptance/investigation, outside commit/integration/CI gates. Preserve failures and exact source/cleanup evidence; neither a reduced workload nor prior-tip timing qualifies changed product code.

entries.title: Flower streaming stability
entries.summary: Indexed ThreadCache and published incremental Markdown apply actor-native changes only to affected text/DOM. Preserve history, code color, copy, focus, selection and disclosure. Semantic changes stay visible; malformed updates recover through the single live-state owner without suppressing output or adding lifecycle.

entries.title: Flower live queue CPU qualification
entries.summary: Ordered queues defer full-history snapshots; global facts and bounded root/child reading have separate owners. Local read failure preserves content/drafts without reconnecting. [Live-state contract](../ui/flower-live-timeline.md) remains authoritative.

entries.title: Flower request-history CPU qualification
entries.summary: Floret v7.79.0 reads canonical request facts once/execution, advancing bounded state after successful writes. Retry/restart reload; lineage validation remains. Redeven bounds sidebar previews and retains sequence members/observers. Three Service/Electron samples reduce median backend CPU80.3%, combined53.9%, allocations87.0%, preserving content/interaction.

entries.title: Flower received output progress
entries.summary: Flower presents dispatched-request waiting/output and provisional edit line counts, then confirmed results. Published Floret v7.42.0 owns in-memory progress/preview lifecycle; Redeven interprets safe product-tool JSON. Presentation adds no journal records or schema changes.

entries.title: Markdown diagram rendering
entries.summary: Flower and file Markdown preserve authored Mermaid while consuming published Floe/Pele. External Pele renders syntax; Floe owns sanitization/scheduling/controls. Redeven binds document identity, semantic palette, locales and context without copying an alternate renderer.

entries.title: Flower code highlighting
entries.summary: Flower owns committed Markdown lifetime; Floe enhanceCodeBlock owns visible tokenization/scheduling/color. Completed labelled fences receive colors in Env App/Desktop while source stays readable/copyable. Highlighting preserves geometry, focus and selection; unavailable or excessive work leaves plain code.

entries.title: Flower message appearance
entries.summary: Shared Flower uses Floe colors for compact reading and contrasting sent-message selection. Themes change paint without disturbing DOM/geometry/selection. Queue stays quieter; forced colors use system roles. Media/cards preserve identity without empty message bubbles.

entries.title: Flower terminal activity presentation
entries.summary: Flower renders canonical Floret Activity with host task labels and safe details for every terminal operation, including writes/empty reads. Disclosure/scroll are ephemeral; no stdin/private paths/effect internals or invented lifecycle. Approval controls remain composer-owned.

entries.title: Flower interactions and context state
entries.summary: Approval/input render Floret pending facts. One bottom action mode prioritizes input_request, then approval, then chat; ordinary thread rail stays interactive. Decision surfaces never make a shared ancestor inert or install pointer-blocking overlays that disable navigation.

entries.title: Asynchronous layout stability
entries.summary: Floe owns geometry; Redeven localized feedback. Async request/copy/refresh/media completion never pushes neighbors or reserves empty rows. Blocking errors stay visible; retained-content errors use disclosure. Only user navigation/disclosure/new records may change layout.

entries.title: Shared interface scale
entries.summary: Published Floe owns type, controls and responsive rows; Redeven maps semantic roles without root scaling or a separate density setting. Desktop uses 13px body/control, 12px supporting and 11px captions. Coarse-pointer fields and targets retain the published touch scale.

entries.title: Flower approval surface
entries.summary: Shared Flower renders keyed canonical approvals within chat space with reachable header/footer. Runtime owns identity/permission/settlement; UI disclosure/feedback. Unavailable pending items remain disabled with reasons; failure preserves content, Stop and navigation.

entries.title: Flower citations
entries.summary: Floret stores assistant sources with end-exclusive Unicode code-point ranges. Flower renders titled links and removes provider markers on Copy. Only safe credential-free HTTP(S) URLs link; marker IDs imply no URL. Historical gaps stay explicit and authored bibliographies remain content.

entries.title: Flower subagent detail window
entries.summary: Child windows read full canonical ThreadView through matching parent-child HTTP/live identities. Activity/queue controls stay attached to that child. Updates retain navigation and scroll; presentation neither copies transcript nor creates a second lifecycle authority.

entries.title: Flower subagent detail presentation
entries.summary: Floret parent-scoped List owns membership; complete child ThreadView owns details. Open stable immediate live windows without polling/reflowing sync UI. Routes require thread_id/task_name; malformed identity or mismatched parent-child fails without inferred legacy aliases.

entries.title: Flower parent event timeline
entries.summary: Floret owns canonical child reports/events and admission; UI owns pages/bodies/disclosure only. Reports appear in the selected parent with canonical child avatars, without receipt/admission/preservation notices. Reading wakes neither task. Every full read rechecks recipient authority and canonical fixed-range paging.

entries.title: Tessiven Runtime discovery and operations
entries.summary: Runtime Tessiven service exposes discovery/dispatch through existing registries/executors. Discovery starts no process/session; path refs grant no access. Changed identity/generation/revocation stops calls. Lost mutation replies stay uncertain pending original-operation inspection.

entries.title: Tessiven Flower and operations
entries.summary: The redeven-tessiven skill maps authorized code/configuration/Runtime facts into canvas versions. Flower edits content; existing service/container managers own resource actions. Lost mutation replies remain unknown: inspect original manager state before any new attempt.

entries.title: Authorized platform model gateway
entries.summary: Redeven discovers authorized models via trusted control-channel lease/origin; Runtime never receives platform Provider keys. Floret owns execution/tools/history/recovery; platform Edge admission/binding/reservations/accounting. Routing does not transfer these ownership boundaries.

entries.title: Model directory and selection
entries.summary: Runtime owns atomic metadata. Reads/send preflight use shipped/saved snapshots; refresh never blocks configured chat. Background refresh is disclosed, opt-in and excludes OpenRouter. OpenRouter/Ollama discover on addition; manual refresh remains available.

entries.title: Model web search
entries.summary: Redeven resolves provider/model search preferences once for settings and turns; final tools drive prompt/wire. Floret v7.40.2 validates hosted events against frozen requests. Undeclared hosted execution fails because remote effects cannot safely be assumed absent.

entries.title: Local ChatGPT plan authentication
entries.summary: OpenAI uses explicit API-key or ChatGPT-account auth; omission preserves API keys. ChatGPT uses public contracts, never Codex secrets. Floret owns history/provider execution; Redeven owns protected local credentials/config/UI. Billing never switches silently and callers never receive secrets.

entries.title: ChatGPT account lifecycle
entries.summary: Protected account storage owns verified identity/sessions, independent of connection editing; email is no identity key. OAuth retry refreshes inputs, renewal/logout serialize tokens, and failed persistence blocks use. Durable local logout tracks cleanup; remote revocation is separate.

entries.title: Provider configuration validation
entries.summary: Redeven owns configuration, credentials and Flower readiness across every settings entrypoint and provider-bundle save. Floret's public runtime contract is unchanged. Invalid saves preserve configuration and credentials; authentication/network failures remain execution errors.

entries.title: Provider API and catalog review
entries.summary: Runtime, Web, Desktop and iOS share one authenticated catalog. Official contracts and pinned models.dev inventory require released adapters and qualified limits, replay, tools, images and reasoning. Refreshes preserve configured model selections and stored conversation identities.

entries.title: Direct image reading and tool media retention
entries.summary:
image.read inspects authorized files/snapshots. Redeven owns bytes/authorization;
Floret owns history/membership. File references stay references; results use native
images, not browsers, temporary servers or Base64 result JSON. Original snapshots
remain available after model preparation.

entries.title: AI tool runtime
entries.summary: Redeven registers typed tools with product policy, presentation and effects; Floret owns admitted conversations, invocations, approval and history. This concept indexes focused tool, terminal, model, thread and subagent contracts. Detailed behavior belongs with its owner, without a duplicate implementation inventory.

entries.title: Flower storage ownership and migrations
entries.summary: Floret owns canonical Agent formats; Redeven owns product facts and uploads. Supported state upgrades through stable kinds, contiguous atomic migrations and public APIs while preserving history. Unknown, future, drifted or invalid state blocks Flower without resetting data or disabling the core Runtime.

entries.title: Flower backup and recovery
entries.summary: Readiness drains generations while storage owners snapshot/migrate and Floret ends execution. Freeze Flower writes, verify collections and retain backups; restore history/settings/read-state/uploads without stopping other surfaces. Failures preserve recovery, never replay effects or roll back binaries.

entries.title: Flower historical writer acceptance
entries.summary: Immutable fixtures come from locked released Redeven writers; current tests copy and verify them. Supported history must remain readable and continue after upgrade. Preserve source/module digests and public write paths. Fixture drift or upgrade failure blocks integration; database open alone is insufficient.

entries.title: Flower attachment resources
entries.summary: Redeven owns authenticated bytes/metadata/quotas/retention; Floret turn membership. Upload once, submit opaque attachment_id, render attachment://v1 and revalidate provider resources. Paths remain private; invalid identity/claims/digest/bytes reject only the affected reference.

entries.title: AI tool permissions and dispatch
entries.summary: Redeven owns product visibility, policy, prompt and approval UI; Floret owns invocation and neutral tools. Current thread permission applies at the next boundary, while each admitted call retains its snapshot. Ordinary independent calls may authorize together; invalid authority rejects and dependent work waits.

entries.title: Computer and browser use runtime
entries.summary: ComputerUseRuntime owns targets, resources, control and script processes; Floret owns Agent lifecycle/effects/history. Prefer authorized commands for data, semantics for interaction and images for visual decisions. Missing target/permission/capability fails explicitly without selecting a substitute tab/window/device.

entries.title: Computer semantic snapshots
entries.summary: ComputerUseRuntime normalizes browser, macOS AX and Linux AT-SPI facts into bounded schema v2. Unsupported facts stay absent and relationships stay within the tree. Invalid observations are discarded while confirmed effects/output survive. Metadata grants no input authority and uncertain effects never replay.

entries.title: Computer script execution and semantic observations
entries.summary: One computer.exec is one Floret effect attempt. QuickJS exposes controlled ui/browser/log under ComputerUseRuntime. Same-target loops/navigation compose, but target/permission/private-input changes stop at existing interaction boundaries, preserving confirmed progress without uncertain replay.

entries.title: Computer script read and validation boundaries
entries.summary: Browser/native reads deliver the promised shape or explicit failure; absent observation never becomes empty data. Later read failure preserves confirmed input without replay. Typed document/candidate preflight invalidation with no input/preparation yields `dispatch_status:not_dispatched` and seals the call; it never enters `completed_actions`. [Scripts](computer-use-scripts.md) owns namespace/failure barriers; every read retains permission, privacy and publication checks.

entries.title: Computer source detail and continuation reads
entries.summary:
Source reads make original AX/DOM fields and descendants reachable beyond the
bounded default tree. [Read validation](computer-script-read-contract.md) owns
permissions, privacy and final publication; source detail does not bypass it or grant new target authority.

entries.title: Optional built-in browser installation
entries.summary: Runtime owns optional Chromium installation, enabled by default but downloaded only after authenticated confirmation. Disable cancels/closes/blocks prompts while retaining bytes/site data. Floret owns waiting/continuation; failed verification publishes nothing and exposes Retry/source choice.

entries.title: Built-in browser Linux system preparation
entries.summary: Installation manager owns readiness; short approved Runtime transactions prepare Linux namespaces/dependencies. Preserve sandbox/global AppArmor and admit only catalog bytes at fixed root-owned paths. Separate dependency, sandbox and unknown launch failures; failed publication preserves data.

entries.title: Browser and desktop settings
entries.summary: Both carriers share Browser and desktop settings. Runtime capabilities, thread grants/selection and extension consent are independent. Open/refresh/close grants or launches nothing; failed reads stay unknown and lost targets unavailable. Floret alone owns conversation lifecycle.

entries.title: Guided personal browser connection
entries.summary: Desktop and Env App share browser connection guidance over ComputerUseRuntime and Floret interactions. Users confirm Chrome installation and initial binding; later sessions restore the same environment. This bounded observation UI owns neither execution nor another lifecycle, and verified connections are reused.

entries.title: Chrome connection diagnostics and recovery
entries.summary: Runtime owns readiness/handshakes; both carriers provide host-specific recovery. Installed Chrome/accepted launch proves neither control nor continuation. Distinguish resource/session/launch/status failures; only compatible live profiles enter Floret Respond, without browser substitution.

entries.title: Managed browsers and authorized Chrome tabs
entries.summary: ComputerUseRuntime owns connection, authorization and control for managed Chromium, explicit CDP and Chrome extension through one restricted executor. Selected-tab authority excludes siblings/devices. Disconnect, revocation, closure and uncertain effects stop work without automatic replacement.

entries.title: Semantic desktop operations and explicit control
entries.summary: ComputerUseRuntime owns desktop execution: explicit macOS app window or private Linux Xvfb/D-Bus. Semantic actions prefer native accessibility. Foreground work requires task authorization and honors Stop/takeover; OS permissions alone cannot certify unobtrusive background operation.

entries.title: Computer target selection across threads
entries.summary: ComputerUseRuntime owns discovery/selection over product settings. Users describe work; Flower locates page/window without mandatory settings binding. Selection is working position, not authority. Stale/disconnected/occupied targets fail explicitly while retaining previous selection.

entries.title: Computer use safety pauses and user control
entries.summary: Floret owns questions, answers and continuation; Redeven owns authorized computer effects and private media. Failures remain factual and blocked capture is not a screenshot. Answers pass unchanged without granting authority or replay. Fresh safe observation precedes further input; no second recovery lifecycle exists.

entries.title: Private browser observation and input
entries.summary: Runtime owns observer-bound private pixels/input; Floret takeover/continuation. Bind observer/revision/thread/run/target; disconnect revokes and uncertainty never replays. Canonical answer starts a fresh Run/observation; private input also waits for matching decoded pixels.

entries.title: Computer use media and visual requests
entries.summary:
Redeven owns authorized screenshots; Floret owns history/preparation. Flower
shows frames inline/in Stage. Durable frames and ephemeral samples have separate
lifetimes; tool success does not prove delivery. Model encodings never replace original assets.

entries.title: Flower computer viewer presentation
entries.summary: Floe owns Stage geometry/launcher; Flower projects canonical status and decoded media. Viewing, moving, closing or restoring grants no target/execution authority. Interrupted/private frames retain recovery and cannot borrow unrelated images. The media contract remains the sole authorization/sampling owner.

entries.title: Computer use product qualification
entries.summary: Qualify Computer through built renderer, Runtime, decoder and target adapter. Exact fixture effects, decoded pixels, source/artifact hashes and cleanup prove only the named target/provider scope. HTTP, metadata or model prose is insufficient; uncertain input is never replayed to produce a pass.

entries.title: Computer use provider qualification evidence
entries.summary: Historical runs support [qualification](computer-use-qualification.md) only for their declared platform, provider and build scope. Canonical results and independently observed effects establish execution. Original model, measurement and transport failures remain distinct from subsequent passing runs; no result certifies arbitrary applications.

entries.title: Computer use qualification evidence
entries.summary: Historical runs follow [the acceptance contract](computer-use-qualification.md). Worktree passes do not replace exact-main checks, certify arbitrary applications or erase failures. Retained diagnostics exclude private text and pixels. Each result keeps its original platform, source identity, acceptance boundary and unresolved limitations.

entries.title: Browser and native drag timing qualification
entries.summary:
Browser drag timing is measured from actual input events, with all model and
assertion failures retained. [Script contracts](computer-use-scripts.md) define
behavior; [qualification](computer-use-qualification.md) defines the test lane.
Browser measurements certify only the tested browser paths and durations.

entries.title: Media contention and native read qualification
entries.summary:
The October 28 qualification validates cancellable media-write admission and
native node/subtree completeness. Production uses published Floret v7.88.0;
its existing cancellable inventory and write-gate contract need no upstream
change. Browser, AX and AT-SPI share the same completeness semantics.

entries.title: Computer use paired model measurements
entries.summary: Paired production Flower/Floret/model/browser fixtures compare visual primitives with semantic scripts on the same tasks. Keep all failures and reject missing, duplicate or unmeasured samples. Headless results do not certify native desktop or Chrome focus; those require separate product qualification.

entries.title: Codex computer and browser use design evidence
entries.summary: Versioned official documentation and installed app 26.908.40834/extension 1.26.901.11451 inform command-first routing, AX/script batching and compact observations. They expose neither proprietary implementation nor universal external-window isolation. Flower Runtime remains execution and authorization authority.

entries.title: AI tool approval and interaction runtime
entries.summary: Floret owns approvals/input; Redeven authorizes/presents. Resolve commits results before publication. Since v7.26.0 pending interaction and active projection publish atomically; waiting clears run_progress. Persistence failure stays unresolved; reject/cancel is row-local, not global failure.

entries.title: AI terminal tool runtime
entries.summary: Redeven owns PTYs and bounded output; Floret v7 owns canonical tool calls, interactions, effect attempts, results and Activity. One adapter authorizes execution once and publishes current views. Product SQL stores no parallel terminal lifecycle or effect recovery.

entries.title: Model reasoning capabilities and transport
entries.summary: Published Floret owns reasoning choices, Ollama metadata and wire encoding; Redeven maps verified capabilities and settings. Default, Off, On, effort and budget remain distinct. Invalid selection rejects before dispatch; unknown controls retain model defaults. Active turns keep immutable settings through restart.

entries.title: Flower prompt and rule sources
entries.summary: Every Flower run profile shares one host English base prompt defining Redeven assistant identity, visual output and local delivery. Runtime facts, tool definitions and native Floret guidance retain separate ownership and availability; product identity never replaces them.

entries.title: AI model and context runtime
entries.summary: Redeven persists model/reasoning preferences, credentials and source selection. Floret owns provider context and opaque continuation. Desktop/environment sources stay distinct; typed observations drive usage/compaction. Token input/output limits remain separate and configuration merges preserve unrelated settings.

entries.title: Model provider surface and history
entries.summary: Floret owns canonical provider history/rendering lineage; Redeven supplies model, prompt, permissions and ephemeral overlays at declared boundaries. History stays readable without restoring removed tools or rewriting facts. Surface changes create compatible lineage, never a host continuation store.

entries.title: Model request recovery
entries.summary: Floret owns retry admission, physical-request deadlines and attempt identity. Redeven supplies protocol facts through one adapter and displays the authoritative current view. Frozen input, confirmed tool exchanges and user cancellation retain their existing authority across transport recovery.

entries.title: Model request measurement
entries.summary: Published Floret v7.70.0 owns one pressure calculation: a qualified native prefix plus an estimate of only the remaining frozen input, or the complete estimate when proof does not match. Redeven supplies protocol facts through optional public contracts.

entries.title: Model request reuse
entries.summary: Floret owns reuse decisions/canonical state; Redeven runs one prepared request/Responses consumer. In-memory transport reuse requires matching next canonical state and complete input. Failure follows ordinary turn recovery; supplemental context never enables reuse.

entries.title: Flower context compaction and Goal continuation
entries.summary: Floret v7.74.0 owns compaction, Goal continuation, Stop/Retry/restart. Redeven transmits frozen authorized intent and renders canonical state. Pure compaction ends after install/noop; Goal continuation prepares context then uses existing Engine/current review in the same execution.

entries.title: Model context usage and compaction
entries.summary: Published Floret owns context, compaction and usage; Redeven displays typed snapshots. [Compaction lifecycle](flower-context-compaction.md) owns intent through recovery; [qualification](../operations/flower-compaction-qualification.md) covers deterministic, historical-copy and real-provider checks.

entries.title: Flower context compaction qualification
entries.summary:
Compaction qualification uses isolated state and explicit test lanes. Production
threads are never continued by historical-copy inspection. The [execution contract](../ai/flower-context-compaction.md) owns intent and recovery; [usage presentation](../ai/model-context-usage-and-compaction.md) maps canonical observations.

entries.title: Flower Ollama context qualification
entries.summary: Opt-in Ollama acceptance uses production Flower, gateway and Floret. Native usage must match canonical totals; real compaction preserves facts through restart. Tests own state/proxy; failures never substitute simulated responses or alter the user model configuration.

entries.title: Flower context distribution qualification
entries.summary: Floret 7.60.3 separates native tokens from same-request visible Unicode characters. Historical token categories/remainder attribution are superseded; current [presentation](../ai/flower-managed-model-context.md#presentation) is authoritative. Prior failed checks stay failed and unrelated prompt qualification remains 119/120.

entries.title: Flower Ollama task qualification
entries.summary: Explicit Ollama qualification uses the installed model, production Flower and published Floret. Verify real tool effects, files, processes, canonical views and streams. Failures remain failures without simulated substitutes or automatic reruns. Tests own cleanup and preserve source credentials/configuration.

entries.title: DeepSeek Responses
entries.summary:
Flower routes the DeepSeek provider to the published Floret v7.66.1 Responses gateway.
Floret owns `/responses` rendering, SSE parsing, reasoning, usage normalization,
function-call validation, and opaque provider history. Redeven only maps its
model DTOs and canonical dotted tool names to provider-safe aliases.

entries.title: Flower canonical thread queries
entries.summary:
Flower exposes two read-only tools for finding another readable conversation
and reading its content: `threads.query` and `threads.read`. The tool contract
is intentionally smaller than Floret's published general query API.
`threads.aggregate` is not registered or dispatched.

entries.title: Floret thread runtime integration
entries.summary: Floret v7 ThreadService alone owns active/canonical lifecycle. Redeven authorizes endpoints/resources/provider-tool effects. Send/Respond/Cancel/Retry/CompactContext return typed state before continuation. Canonical records deduplicate; drafts and execution tokens stay transient.

entries.title: Floret Redeven adapter and projection
entries.summary: Redeven authorizes ownership/resources and maps typed Floret views, updates, failures and safe Activity. Floret alone owns lifecycle, persistence, migration, cancellation and provider state. The adapter neither waits on provider work nor mirrors execution or receipts.

entries.title: Flower subagent parent events
entries.summary: Reports/lifecycle remain canonical Floret facts for the direct parent, without another handoff store or idle wakeup. Bounded wait/explicit reads expose them during continuation. Approvals/input stay child interactions; report_to_parent can communicate blockers without ending work.

entries.title: Flower subagent runtime
entries.summary: Floret v7 owns canonical child Threads. Redeven maps product tools/Flower through typed ThreadRuntime without child result/lifecycle/recovery stores. Parent-scoped summaries are bounded status; only canonical child current view supplies complete handoff authority.

entries.title: Flower thread fork coordination
entries.summary: Floret owns Fork journal/destination; Redeven authorizes source/endpoint and adopts settings. One stable request may title that exact destination. Invalid/foreign/conflicting/failed requests stop explicitly; no product saga, canonical copy, recovery coordinator or compensating deletion.

entries.title: Flower thread deletion coordination
entries.summary: Floret deletes canonical threads; Redeven deletes settings, read state, authority and attachment claims. One authenticated request runs owners in that order and succeeds only after both. Synchronous idempotent retry creates no second lifecycle receipt or cross-database atomicity claim.

entries.title: Flower plugin generation
entries.summary: Flower authors applications through the released ReDevPlugin CLI/SDK and version-matched skill. Redeven owns intent, guidance, review and placement; platform owns templates/build/preview/package/execution. Floret owns tool dispatch/approvals; no copied authoring implementation.

entries.title: Flower context action admission
entries.summary: Redeven owns pre-admission context; Floret owns admitted messages/references/facts. One authorized privacy-checked mapper emits ordered references and UserInput.Context without product copies. Malformed/forged/unknown or failed projection rejects while preserving editable draft.

entries.title: Redeven environment operations
entries.summary: Environment lifecycle goes through Redeven product operations, never guessed container/SSH/systemd/launchctl/process commands. Flower receives this rule from the standard redeven-environment skill; do not embed a second environment workflow into the global prompt.

entries.title: OKF bundle lifecycle
entries.summary: Redeven builds its embedded OKF bundle from curated source files under the top-level `okf/` authoring root, verifies deterministic dist outputs under `okf/dist/`, and embeds the resulting bundle into the binary used by Runtime and AI features for local retrieval.

entries.title: OKF tool suite
entries.summary: Redeven exposes the embedded OKF bundle through read-only `okf.index`, `okf.search`, and `okf.open` builtin tools. Redeven projects bounded safe results into Floret v7.26.0 structured Activity rows, and the shared Flower surface expands those rows without reading raw OKF result JSON.

entries.title: Gateway v6 independent device protocol
entries.summary: Gateway v6, authority epoch 70, defines independent client-device trust and Runtime attachments. The public protocol and private host API are separate surfaces on the same service, with independently verified device access and host authority. Cloud machine management and publication are absent.

entries.title: RCPP v5 Cloud API
entries.summary: RCPP v5 separates Cloud authority from route. CloudRuntimeBinding binds Environment/Runtime/Namespace/principal/generation. One Runtime controller owns direct/Gateway enrollment, registration, heartbeat, reserve and recovery; Desktop never duplicates credential ownership.

entries.title: Self-contained installer distribution
entries.summary: Release builds macOS/Linux amd64/arm64 self-contained installers without CGO and renders entry from exact binary digests, all signed via SHA256SUMS. Receiving hosts need no Go/Cosign/Python/OpenSSL/package manager, but require shell, HTTPS downloader and SHA256 utility.

entries.title: CI and release gates
entries.summary: Focused checks precede staged pre-commit and exact-tip main admission. Dependencies, assets, locales and OKF must agree. Browser/Desktop/native/long-thread acceptance remains explicit; releases require authenticated artifacts and same-commit historical-data qualification. Windows is internal-only.

entries.title: ReDevPlugin release artifact gate
entries.summary: Consume the coordinated published ReDevPlugin release with artifacts bound to tag, source, target, digest, signer and receipt. Registry readbacks, native evidence and closed inventories establish provenance. Partial, mutable, Windows or target-mismatched inputs fail before admission.

entries.title: Plugin integration gate
entries.summary: Plugin gate checks released ReDevPlugin Host/market against Redeven authority, placement, renderer and Desktop lifecycle. Use published packages/isolated profiles; copied platform paths, implicit grants, second bridges and stale projections fail instead of fabricating integration.

entries.title: OKF release assets
entries.summary: Releases distribute OKF manifest and SHA256 verification assets alongside CLI/Desktop packages and signed SHA256SUMS. The signed aggregate remains their public integrity anchor; standalone verification files never replace authenticated release checksums or source provenance.

entries.title: Automated service-template catalog updates
entries.summary: The template repository publishes immutable recommendations. Redeven daily/manual adoption pins public Go checksums, regenerates notices/OKF and passes normal integration checks. Failure retains published main and uncertain push requires ref inspection. Adoption never upgrades installed service instances.

entries.title: Flower managed runtime facts
entries.summary: Floret v7.47.1 owns chronological admission, semantic updates, context messages, compaction and recovery. Flower only collects/presents authorized complete facts in four partitions: execution environment, date/timezone, repository rule sources and available skills.

sections.title: Contract

## Mechanism
Floret renders reference display content and snapshots into canonical model history for execution and compaction, preserving order across follow-ups.

Lease release follows the canonical terminal view, not the HTTP response or Desktop connection lifetime, so an existing session cannot admit hidden work after the final lifecycle snapshot.

OAuth retry refreshes inputs, renewal/logout serialize tokens, and failed persistence blocks use. Durable local logout tracks cleanup; remote revocation is separate.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Sign-in and registration
One `chatgpt.Client` owns bounded, five-minute in-memory attempts.

Interrupted logout is completed at startup; normal maintenance scans never clear a live logout.

## Renewal and credential coordination
[Account maintenance](../../internal/chatgpt/lifecycle.go) starts with the Runtime service, independently of AI readiness, connection bindings and open windows. Runtime shutdown cancels maintenance without signing out and never schedules OS background work.

Account updates use model_directory.changed and merge independently of drafts.

## Logout and connection changes
Sign-out first records intent and stops related tasks through Floret's existing immediate Cancel with descendants. The private Desktop model source observes current account facts once per second and passes confirmed account stop reasons to its owning Runtime; it never owns another task lifecycle.

The Runtime Service protocol, secrets schema, Floret public API and domain migration remain unchanged.

concepts.summary: OpenAI uses explicit API-key or ChatGPT-account auth; omission preserves API keys. ChatGPT uses public contracts, never Codex secrets. Floret owns history/provider execution; Redeven owns protected local credentials/config/UI. Billing never switches silently and callers never receive secrets.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Local host admission
The authenticated Runtime settings response publishes `auth_capabilities` with an `openai_chatgpt` availability, disabled reason and connection binding. Desktop identity, loopback URL text, renderer headers and client declarations cannot establish local access.

That source executes against the local account store; the remote settings page exposes no account login, credential transfer or account email.

## Account lifecycle
The [ChatGPT account lifecycle](chatgpt-account-lifecycle.md) is the canonical owner of registration, verified sign-in persistence, issued-client retry, local saved-account selection, renewal, cancellation cleanup and logout. Connection saves and explicit logout have separate results.

## Model and request contracts
The public account model endpoint's listed models preserve server order and are intersected with reviewed adapter capabilities. ChatGPT connections reject custom endpoints, API credentials and custom model declarations.

No error silently switches authentication or API billing.

concepts.title: Computer script read and validation boundaries

frontmatter.title: Computer script read and validation boundaries

concepts.summary: Browser/native reads deliver the promised shape or explicit failure; absent observation never becomes empty data. Later read failure preserves confirmed input without replay. Typed document/candidate preflight invalidation with no input/preparation yields `dispatch_status:not_dispatched` and seals the call; it never enters `completed_actions`. [Scripts](computer-use-scripts.md) owns namespace/failure barriers; every read retains permission, privacy and publication checks.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Validation and lifetime
All guest/image/download-cursor methods validate min/max arity before dispatch. Extras yield SCRIPT_ARGUMENT_ERROR with method/documented_arity; existing signatures/type/options remain. Empty/zero/null are valid only where promised. Normal input-sequence delivery receipts, including an explicitly requested delay with no posted input, are distinct from typed document invalidation. The adapter returns TARGET_OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE for typed invalidation. Missing/malformed observations seal the call; never fabricate trees. Explicit snapshot/observe/screenshot and readonly locator on_invalidated:return can branch on the restricted typed document-change result defined by [scripts](computer-use-scripts.md).

One boundary covers node/text/query/table/attribute/condition and lower-level faults, retaining semantic_read/source identity. Whole-page reads/screenshots bind the page revision through publication. Ref-scoped content binds existing target/ancestor/main document records; unrelated child replacement alone need not invalidate it. Entry/final privacy scans remain page-wide and may fail independently. Enumerated frames retain their original document record through detach, including a change before dispatch; invalidated records reject without stale protocol calls. Inventory fenced across successful frame enumeration cannot reinstall retired documents. Unknown inventory protocol faults remain unknown. No second lifecycle ledger. Scan ordinary reads at entry/publication; failed publication retires image. No page-quiescence requirement. text() samples innerText, document.URL and title in one browser evaluation, with frame/document/ref identity. Other combined reads fence same-document route events; normal DOM mutations do not invalidate a document. A contemporaneous route with old application data is still source truth for the model to judge.

Empty child-frame URL requires document.URL from that exact isolated frame with unchanged lifecycle/origin/privacy checks. Never substitute parent or allowlist blank. Missing/invalid URL fails without malformed reply/disconnection; later explicit same-page reads may recover. Keep input confirmation separate.

## Condition waits
One deadline covers preparation/entry safety/samples, cleanup and final publication. Check privacy each sample without rereading title/URL. Return requested_state/timeout_ms/elapsed_ms/samples, not readiness. Timeout is data; requireState raises CONDITION_TIMEOUT, seals calls even if caught, preserves completed prefix. Diagnostics include method/state/timeout/zero-based operation_index and failed_action/failed_operation_index, excluding matching text/raw exception. Completed wait need not match.

Typed document_changed/candidate_changed invalidation distinguishes the actual lost identity and discards only its sample, preserving deadline/privacy latch. Protocol rejection requires lifecycle evidence for the exact frame/document read; arbitrary global revision changes and error wording cannot authorize resampling. Scoped invalidation facts retain safety/content scope, frame/event and protocol method. Revalidate original unique query/scope after state read; even absence requires valid fixed scope. Invalid samples cannot mean absent/hidden. Ambiguity/stale refs or root_ref/unknown protocol or evaluation/permission/cancel stops. Ordinary reads/input never retry candidate faults.

## Navigation and delivery
Script navigate/back/reload: wait_until commit|domcontentloaded|load, timeout_ms0..30000, defaults load/20000. Return command_acknowledged/navigation_stage/wait{state:reached|timeout,wait_until,timeout_ms,elapsed_ms}. Correlate root/loader milestones, including pre-ack events; explicitly report same-document/download. Deadline begins before dispatch. Timeout permits explicit read/wait in same namespace; network/unknown ack/permission/cancel/target change stops. No replay/network-idle heuristic.

Pointer/key/text/fill/wheel/drag/sequences return closed delivery facts/needs_observation/observation_invalidated, no page read/business-success claim. Optional safety failure yields bounded post_action_check.state=unavailable, neither revoking ack nor publishing unchecked content. Confirmed private input pauses; permission/cancel/connection/target/cleanup/uncertain barriers stop. Later reads own full privacy; content-returning edits/legacy image calls retain observation boundaries.

## Evaluation and action facts
One Runtime.evaluate/callFunctionOn checker rejects exceptionDetails, missing or operation-invalid result; promised false/zero/empty/null and void install/reset undefined remain valid. Only same-document confirmed installation updates prepared-frame map. Explicit later read may prepare again, never replay input/navigation/call; observer readiness is not app readiness.

Evaluation facts: phase=evaluation, actual method, exception|invalid_result. DOMSnapshot validates used fields, accepts protocol-empty, omits unavailable offsets; invalid shape retains adapter/method/invalid_result. Transport retains known method without invented code; wrapping preserves typed invalidation. Unknown faults keep stage/internal_error. Canonical result/Activity/correlated logs exclude exception text/stacks/page values. Prior output survives except privacy takeover. Help uses observed roles/refs, not business guesses.

Separate preparation, acknowledged events and requested-operation completion: action_executed confirms completion; preparation_executed requests fresh read without adding click/scroll to completed_actions. Partial posted/observed counts imply no business success. Unknown delivery/release stays uncertain; mutating-evaluation exception cannot confirm completion. Hit-test diagnostics name point_coordinates/point_node/target_ancestry/embedding_frames/scroll_intersection without DOM text. Resolve CSSPseudoElement to origin before ordinary ancestor/shadow checks; unrelated overlays reject without alternate points/targets. Flower distinguishes prepared/partial interruption; failed_operation_phase never describes completed prefix.

Text layout uses Range rectangles; elements/documents use native geometry. Unsupported measurement fails explicitly, never invents hidden state. connected/rendered/visible/opacity_zero/enabled/editable/receives stay distinct. Offscreen text can be visible. Transparent rendered pointer targets require real hit ownership; hover need not be enabled, click must be enabled, fill must be editable. Rejections expose closed stage/state/bounds facts. Root hit checks avoid unrelated frame enumeration; OOPIF checks validate known ancestor documents and overlays.

## Bounded reads/input
Validate whole operation before virtual focus/scroll/input. Diagnostics contain phase/field/expected/recovery, not secrets/page errors. Keys are characters/documented names with Alt/Control/Meta/Shift; physical Equal invalid. Primitive computer.wait defaults zero, no settling promise; legacy waitFor retains state.

query(limit,cursor) reads authorized loaded AX attributes with total/truncation/document/cursor. Content change invalidates cursor; store only returned refs. Page<=200 items/48KiB; virtual unloaded rows unvisited. href retains relative/query/fragment, redacts credentials; legacy linkSummary is explicitly lossy and absent from default examples. Long fields use source reads.

rows requires unique table/grid, excludes nested tables, returns header/data/cell roles/source refs. Page<=200 rows/48KiB; row<=200 cells/44KiB; cell<=2000 Unicode characters. cells_truncated/text_truncated disclose loss; incomplete rows prove no exact total. Cursor binds full cell content. count=loaded matches. attribute(name)=string|null and getAttribute(name)={attribute,value,redacted?} accept any exact nonempty DOM attribute name up to 2000 characters; absent differs from empty. Values over 2000 code points fail explicitly; source() provides chunks. URL-bearing attributes remove credentials explicitly while preserving query/fragment and relative source. Hidden credential inputs retain the same privacy boundary. Deprecated linkSummary deliberately removes query/fragment; no default recommendation. Native rejects browser-only before dispatch.

scroll_progress stays return-only; scope/measured_ref identifies requested element/viewport, not guessed wheel receiver. before/after/offset_changed are immediate; scroll_effect unknown; invalid/unavailable samples null. Preparation/input separate. Wheel uses clipped/transformed visible intersection (document viewport), not enabled state/offscreen center. Check ancestry/embedding overlay before one wheel; reject with preparation facts, no alternative search/replay.

No repeated-read advisor or implicit diff chooses the next action. Truncation retains read_options/root/limit/continuation; model chooses. Node detail is not subtree; child_refs covers returned relations and children_truncated flags loss. Collections use snapshots/loaded rows/query/count.

concepts.title: Managed browsers and authorized Chrome tabs

frontmatter.title: Managed browsers and authorized Chrome tabs

concepts.summary: ComputerUseRuntime owns connection, authorization and control for managed Chromium, explicit CDP and Chrome extension through one restricted executor. Selected-tab authority excludes siblings/devices. Disconnect, revocation, closure and uncertain effects stop work without automatic replacement.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Explicit Browser and desktop connection/tab creation selects the conversation target. Approval Required binds current target/URL; temporary URL authority never becomes saved origin permission. This is neither a model tool nor another opening path.

## Managed profiles
Both carriers use /_redeven_proxy/api/browser/installation. Default profiles lazily create their first page; later selected-page loss fails explicitly.

Under published FloeBrowser ownership, Go Runtime launches one sandboxed Chromium process group/profile; Node inventory/source adapters attach to loopback CDP. Retain Playwright isolation flags: basic profile-local credential storage/mock keychain, sandbox enabled. Never access personal keychains/request keychain permission. Passive inventory never launches Chrome. Explicit Start creates no page/target change and reuses its owner.

Explicit Stop confirms page closure with saved sign-ins/downloads retained. Gates reject Stop during action/task/private-control/viewer ownership. Retire authority before releasing gates; queued work cannot restart/replace the old page. Running/idle/stopped/failed state comes from Runtime, not profile metadata.

One maintenance worker probes once/minute; release requires ten minutes with zero actual pages, unfinished downloads and target owners. Retained pages are intentional resources. Passive reads do not reset idleness; failed probes prove nothing.

Shutdown cancels maintenance, closes owned groups independently of helper responsiveness, then escalates bounded graceful→terminate→kill. Remove receipts only after confirmed cleanup; retain/return failure, including disable/recovery. A profile kernel lock lasts for owner lifetime. Atomic receipts bind PID/birth, executable, profile and owner PID/birth. Next explicit start may reclaim a verified obsolete owner; ambiguous/live/invalid identities fail. Never scan/kill Chrome by executable name. Spawn-before-receipt and uncatchable-kill-without-restart cleanup are not guaranteed. Receipts prove cleanup identity, not authority/history/replay. Only isolated protocol fixtures may use helper launch; production stays Runtime-managed.

## Input and observation
Semantic clicks check visible/enabled/stable geometry and actual hit target, including parent overlays. Preparation is not input completion: blocked clicks return action_executed:false and fresh-observation demand after viewport change. Bounded waits sample rendered CSS; labels use safe observed titles, never discovery as account identity.

Same-document capture may settle read-only for <=1s within budget; check before/after capture. Persistent motion returns capture/viewport_unstable without pixels. Cancellation/document change/privacy latch wins; never replay input. Frame inventory owns document identity: child navigation/removal revokes its subtree; root replacement/cancel/handback revokes all. Image/snapshot revisions stay page-wide; ref reads recheck document after DOM/AX.

Locator keys require focusable elements; AX roots use ui.key('PageDown'). Exact DOM.focus/document rejection yields ELEMENT_NOT_ACTIONABLE, focus/not_focusable, no key/connection retirement. Generic faults/lost focus/unknown acknowledgements or release stay uncertain without replay; retain safe stage/reason/fresh-read demand, warning and completed prefix.

Hit tests convert viewport CSS into owning CDP document coordinates, including scrolled frames, and check every cross-process embedding overlay. Unavailable protocol yields TARGET_OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE/observation_stage:hit_test, never invented coverage. Capture includes non-overlay scrollbars and an immutable actual-dimension transform with before/after checks. Scoped scroll verifies its control-center hit target.

## Downloads
Capture browser.downloadCursor() before input; sequential waitForDownload({after:cursor}) or exact known ID follows. Bounded page-local memory excludes old files; multiple arrivals are ambiguous. No replay/latest-file inference/durable ledger. Published SourceDownload alone writes identity; raw CDP cannot duplicate it. Same names remain distinct; AMBIGUOUS_DOWNLOAD includes bounded exact candidates.

readDownload(id,{offset,limit}) returns bounded base64/continuation; sequential chunks share a short-lived stream retired on cancel/idle/disposal. saveDownload(id) copies <=256MiB into task scratch with run authorization/partial cleanup and per-chunk offset/count/identity/total validation. Guests cannot choose paths; terminal/file tools process the returned path and deliver finals.

## Chrome extension and CDP
MV3 uses Native Messaging/chrome.debugger for the exact tab. Bounded webNavigation creation facts identify popup source; tab-group opener metadata is not action provenance. Remote Linux uses remote managed browser/private desktop, never silent local Chrome.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Internal cancellation drains the operation before clearing its ephemeral flag; it never sets user_control or changes private mode/permission/Stop barriers. Drained reads permit authorized same-target reads; uncertain writes remain terminal. Invalidated captures without bytes/attachments retain observation_invalidated/needs_observation; inconsistent target/safety/frame payloads fail.

Recovery uses ordinary profile preparation; private input cannot own another default profile and passive sampling launches nothing. [Design evidence](computer-use-design-evidence.md) records public/installed-code comparisons; no forced reload/CSP rewriting. Pre-identity failure cannot bind guessed downloads. Generic unavailable events neither latch globally nor infer names/times; waits may time out until identity-bearing upstream failure exists.

## User contract
The shared Browser and desktop dialog opens Browser settings for this environment.

Users never choose a file   or follow an archive download link.

No agent installation tool, automatic re-enable, shell fallback or target substitution is introduced.

## Distribution and state
Standard Runtime release suites carry `computer.zip`: official Node, published Playwright, QuickJS, the published FloeBrowser SDK and its native media collector, and product helpers, with a closed SHA-256 file inventory.

Offline delivery retains this helper suite and does not include Chromium. Missing browser binaries remain an explicitly confirmed online installation; packaging optimization cannot initiate downloads or change browser selection. The media collector is selected for the suite target before the closed inventory is generated, preserving the upstream manifest as evidence and enforcing runtime digest checks. macOS signing derives the selected runtime digest only after verifying unchanged executable content; see [Desktop bundle contracts](../desktop/desktop-development-bundles.md).

The Runtime never accepts a client-supplied URL, executable path or checksum.

No installation automatically restarts following a Runtime restart.

Runtime independently checks the installed version and policy before accepting the ready phase.

Connection observation remains bounded to the open guide; pressing Connect or copying the manual connection link starts a fresh observation window after installation, timeout or a failed check.

concepts.summary: ComputerUseRuntime owns desktop execution: explicit macOS app window or private Linux Xvfb/D-Bus. Semantic actions prefer native accessibility. Foreground work requires task authorization and honors Stop/takeover; OS permissions alone cannot certify unobtrusive background operation.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## macOS windows
The Swift helper inventories regular and accessory application windows, reads AX roles, labels, non-sensitive values, supported actions and bounds, and exposes bounded subtree queries.

Application discovery reuses HostApplicationCatalog; exact candidate selection
uses NSWorkspace with current app/foreground permission. Launch completion is
synchronized, cancellation stops further actions, and window readiness is bounded.
Minimized windows are restored once and allowed to settle; zero/multiple windows
return explicit selection facts. No path-supplied shell launcher or independent
application lifecycle is exposed to guest scripts.

Secret fields enter the existing private takeover channel rather than model observations.

Snapshots declare source macos_accessibility and application_provided coverage.
truncated:false means the available tree was not cut, not that all visible content
is present. Use screenshots and targeted scrolling when application AX content
is sparse. No global accessibility opt-in attribute is forced.

## Explicit interaction and effects
The published floe-native-apps v0.26.0 owns pointer events, timed sequences,
window/PID routing and pasteboard primitives. Redeven owns target/process checks,
authorization, cancellation, source serialization and result facts. Directed input
requires a live window route; missing optional WindowServer support fails without
foreground substitution. Receipts count delivered events, not application effects.
Cancellation releases only task-owned transitions at the last posted position.
AX actions retain existing foreground consent because applications may activate.

The script facade exposes hover, left/right/middle and modified clicks, holds,
selection read/text/ranges/all/replacement, discovered AX actions, values and
bounded input sequences. UTF-16 selections reject split surrogates. Browser
counterparts use CDP input, DOM selection or explicitly identified synthetic
control events. Preflight rejects unsupported controls before mutation.

Native key/press and copy/cut/paste select the existing consented foreground route before dispatch: AppKit may receive a background chord without executing its menu action. No automatic foreground retry follows directed input. AX selection ranges have no direction contract; non-none directions fail before mutation. Explicit input preserves modifiers and repeat, and cancellation releases only posted task-owned keys/buttons.

Copy/cut preserve their actual editing semantics; paste is independent of fill.
System clipboard read/write/paste requires Full access plus platform permission.
Typed bytes and formats are explicit. Supplied paste leaves the clipboard when
consumption is unverified; it never restores over a concurrent user copy. Browser
setFiles uses supplied bytes only (16 files, 256 KiB encoded), never arbitrary host
paths. Existing target discovery/selection, downloads and native file dialogs
retain their authorization boundaries. Capabilities describe support conditions;
unsupported application controls fail explicitly.

## Linux private desktop
The Xvfb owner starts a private session D-Bus and AT-SPI bus. The executor rejects socket or environment paths leading outside that private desktop; it never discovers or attaches to another logged-in user's session.

Product target preferences and canonical historical results follow their existing owners.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Overview and navigation
The overview identifies the actual Runtime hostname and platform, then shows the page or app used by the current conversation and three environment entries: built-in headless browser, Chrome in this environment, and desktop/applications. Opening or enabling never downloads.

Both carriers provide complete explicit localized copy.

## Runtime observation and recovery
`GET computer/environment` returns hostname, platform, managed-browser capability, desktop capability, and the existing live Chrome status snapshot. Capability is an observation, not an authorization or a guarantee that subsequent startup cannot fail.

Published Floe components already supply the required UI primitives, so this change is product integration rather than an upstream platform extension.

concepts.summary:
Redeven owns authorized screenshots; Floret owns history/preparation. Flower
shows frames inline/in Stage. Durable frames and ephemeral samples have separate

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
- Missing, changed or unauthorized bytes fail explicitly. No unrestricted URL fallback.
- [Image reads](image-read-and-retention.md) share immutable Computer storage;
  computer:// identities and retention stay intact.
- Safe results include target, location, summary and safety. Semantic/script
  operations include images only when requested.
- All authorized model images use published Floret PrepareModelImage: JPEG quality
  85 and a 2560-pixel longest side, without upscaling. Uploads, image.read/crops,
  browser/native screenshots, MCP images, summaries and historical replay share
  this policy. Alpha remains PNG; EXIF orientation is applied and ICC retained.
  An animation stays byte-identical when it fits; oversized animation fails
  explicitly without flattening frames. An unchanged smaller original may be kept.
- Canonical original bytes, hashes, locators and visible history never change.
  Model notices report source/model dimensions and bytes; fine text can be read
  through an original-backed crop. Preparation never fetches arbitrary URLs.
- Preparation precedes estimation/freezing. Transport retries reuse exact bytes;
  Desktop RPC carries validated derived metadata to prevent lossy recompression.
  Encoding revisions invalidate provider state. No durable derivative cache exists.
- Flower caps JSON/base64 at 32 MiB independently of tokens: product policy,
  not a provider limit. Remote DTOs share the cap; services own final rendering.
- Media dimension/count/byte failures retain typed actual/limit/stage through
  Desktop RPC and canonical failure projection. Published Floret v7.94.0 recovers
  aggregate count/total-byte failures through safe historical compaction even
  with low token usage. Individual invalid/dimension failures remain terminal;
  neither class aliases token overflow. UI provides numeric
  diagnostics and input/model guidance without unchanged Retry or secret payloads.

## Screenshot coordinates
A model screenshot returns frame_geometry with its computer:// identity, original
image dimensions and model_image dimensions. Browser geometry also carries CSS
visual viewport scale/offset. Screenshot handles use model_pixels plus frame and
document_id; explicit browser image_pixels retains original pixel semantics.
Default browser CSS and native window coordinates keep their existing units.
Native window screenshots support model_pixels with a transient window anchor.
Full-page/cropped arbitrary images do not establish an input mapping.

Each controller holds one model anchor. Viewer sampling cannot replace it.
Changed target, document, viewport, bounds or observed native accessibility state
rejects stale input. Input and takeover invalidate the anchor. Known-change
checks cannot eliminate arbitrary dynamic layout races; semantic locators remain
preferable for moving controls. The final attachment supplies after_frame when
several screenshots were taken.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Browser observation and private input
The shared browser controller enforces visible password fields, structured
one-time-code input semantics, secret-change latches and explicit permissions in
each frame, including shadow roots. Native adapters enforce platform secure-field
roles. They do not classify ordinary labels or page prose as CAPTCHA, OTP or
instruction attacks. Observed content is untrusted data, never authorization.
The model decides task meaning and whether human help is needed; it never receives
confirmed protected values or pixels for classification. Unmarked secrets are not
guaranteed detectable by accessibility; native apps must expose secure fields and
users retain explicit takeover control. An unreadable frame stops the observation
without inventing a human requirement. Unknown read failures are not retried;
only measured viewport instability has a one-second same-target resampling window
inside the invocation budget. Explicit condition waits own their original deadline
through final publication and resample only typed identity invalidation. Failed
wait samples retain elapsed time and sample count without claiming a condition result.

See [guided connection](computer-use-browser-connection.md).

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Evidence/isolation
Retain canonical results,fixture events,frames,hashes,cleanup and original assertion/model/product failures. Never repeat until green. Native/provider/foreground suites remain explicit outside ordinary/exact-main gates. Real Service/public UI verifies result-encoding loss after one counted effect/invalid optional result. Browser/native share pre-input cancel/revoke and terminal unknown-ack behavior.

## DeepSeek
TestComputerReliabilityDeepSeek uses production Service/Floret,configured deepseek-flash (local V4.1 Flash1017),catalog Chromium,no substitute. Require REDEVEN_COMPUTER_RELIABILITY_E2E=1,absolute REDEVEN_COMPUTER_CONFIG_ROOT/EVIDENCE_DIR,REDEVEN_BROWSER_TEST_INSTALLATION. Run GOWORK=off go test ./internal/ai -run '^TestComputerReliabilityDeepSeek$' -count=1 -v -timeout=22m. Repeat1..5(default1);browser-only may -parallel3. Native:REDEVEN_COMPUTER_NATIVE_E2E=1,released Swift helper,serialized desktop;absolute REDEVEN_COMPUTER_NATIVE_TEST_HOST may select baseline. Preserve config/secret hashes/user threads.

Use default tools except explicit legacy-wait. Cover bounded text/budgets,confirmed prefixes,pre-focus validation,paging/image identity,delays/titles/staleness/options,scroll/conditions/natural work,timeout/below-fold,exact async text,landmarks/reset,scripts/downloads/app entry. Decode Floret ERROR/host envelope via ThreadToolResultReader. Script diagnostics require data.script_error; pre-dispatch rejection distinct. Prose/logs never replace execution; completed waits survive guest faults.

| Case | Required independent facts |
| --- | --- |
| capture/refs | Four PageDown then screenshot; parent ref survives child navigation |
| options/waits | Exact bad field/index/safe condition |
| stale/image | STALE_REFERENCE/zero pointer; image then one pointer |
| visual/form/table | Varied positions/labels/sizes; screenshot before click; exact values/totals |
| batch | Three reads,>=two transitions in one script,screenshot; independently checked totals |
| download | One export/save ID,exact bytes,terminal-created project file; no anonymous read after acquisition |
| native entry | Discovery/confirmed choice,exact text,one click/image |
| optional/caught | Zero/timeout can branch; caught failed unique lookup cannot resume input |
| observed roles | Search controls with different observed roles; three exact values/one submit |
| evaluation | One injected fault retains method/reason/prefix;zero later input,fresh image |
| output loss | Prior output retained;one fault/zero later input,actual method/no invented code |
| host rejection | Real empty helper rejects before dispatch;canonical non-execution/prior text,zero later input |
| drag | Independent down/up/moves/endpoints/time;bad integer_0_5000 before input |
| lifetime | Content/image/metadata/safety through cleanup;child waits/fixed refs/privacy/cancel/unknown faults |
| dynamics | Natural/explicit wait,SPA,shadow form,unrelated continuous changes |
| public reads | MDN/Wikipedia/GitHub title/heading/image;real evidence including emit:false,no forbidden tools |

Also test>2800 nodes,complete totals,account/tab separation,older same-name download,save then diagnostic failure without replay. Retain wire/errors/history/events/answers; success proves neither remote weights nor universal reliability.

## Browser/native
Semantic scroll tests document/tall/clipped/covered: one valid wheel,zero rejected;measure preparation separately. Real extension CDP/AX faults retain method/code,zero input,explicit same-ref recovery. Managed frame/shadow/transform/malformed-read checks use real zoom/DPR.

Exact maintained batch/download examples execute QuickJS→Runtime→Chromium,verifying multichunk bytes/one export-ID,page values/image. Native entry tests0/1/multiple/minimized windows; real Swift scroll/image/focus restoration is invalidated by external input.

Independent AppKit receiver measures drag0/1/500/5000ms plus interrupted5000ms,one down/up and early endpoint. Fixture key-window changes require factual pause,balanced release,explicit recovery,never replay. Real model timed/invalid/zero/focus-change uses production receipts. Browser image/timing/cancel tests cover both hosts,not native timing.

## Carriers
Built Desktop uses isolated exact provider config,rejects missing/overridden identity;observe preload workspace stream. Linux Webtop may passively copy CDP. Missing decoded browser/native frame fails scope;name unqualified platform/native/connected-Chrome lanes.

checkDesktopSystemBrowser.mjs uses built Desktop/Runtime/extension/Native Messaging and deterministic provider:canonical help before target,continuation after verified connection. Existing media/takeover owns previews. Delete owned threads/servers/exact process trees,verify ports. Late decode/expired interaction/queue/selection/close remain separate deterministic boundaries.

concepts.title: Computer and browser use runtime
concepts.summary: ComputerUseRuntime owns targets, resources, control and script processes; Floret owns Agent lifecycle/effects/history. Prefer authorized commands for data, semantics for interaction and images for visual decisions. Missing target/permission/capability fails explicitly without selecting a substitute tab/window/device.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Execution
`computer.observe` reads bounded semantic information, with an optional image.
Inside `computer.exec`, `await ui.observe({emit:false})` returns a local object with
`observation.nodes`; script reads receive the full observation. The `full:true`
option controls the emitted snapshot instead of the default diff.

See the [adapter result contract](floret-redeven-adapter-and-projection.md).

## Platform adapters
The [browser contract](computer-use-browser.md) covers managed profiles, explicit CDP tabs and same-device Chrome extension bindings.

Stage viewing uses its independent bounded sampler; those samples never enter model history. See [Computer media](computer-use-media.md).

## Task access
Each computer invocation receives the permission snapshot established at its tool authorization boundary. Opaque origins never become origin grants.

Target selection chooses where work runs; it is not another confirmation of an already authorized action.

## Packaging and compatibility
Browser execution JSONL and Native Messaging use protocol 6 for Runtime-owned pause control, explicit page selection, reveal, popup progress and confirmed progress on observation failure.

Native window capture continues to respect Desktop-window exclusion and never substitutes an unrestricted display capture after failure.
