sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Plugin component tests cover first reveal, document visibility, hide while
opening, unopened close/disposal, context/retry, unknown outcomes and sibling
retirement. Production resource and UI fixtures verify inputs, native undo,
selection, close veto, focus, fresh origins and zero final frames. Runtime
qualification uses finite fuel/deadlines, memory bounds, cancellation and
revocation. Linux sealed static PIE/clone3/seccomp and macOS hardened workloads
pass upstream. Product Docker lifecycle, published source consumption and live
author execution pass. An isolated native Desktop build also starts its local
environment and Plugin Center. Its exact bundled hardened runtime executes the
current published author Worker successfully through production Integration;
this does not certify the separate full Desktop I/O workflow.

Both independent product endurance runs complete. The candidate browser passes
100 unique-origin churn cycles and 30 minutes with 357 input/visibility/selection
checks, native undo, close veto and sibling-preserving retirement; final live
frames, page/HTTP errors and observed guest long tasks are all zero. Input plus
switch P95 is 22.83 ms (baseline 23.02 ms). Candidate process-tree RSS during the
soak is 1,065.02 MiB initially and 502.25 MiB at the last live sample; it is
505.95 MiB after frame cleanup. RSS includes shared pages and retained browser
allocations, so this is bounded-duration evidence rather than proof of no leak.

Candidate Worker endurance completes 30m4.40s: 359 batches, 1,436 correct calls,
359 expected application rejections, three normal gateway renewals and successful
Integration close. The host and runtime exit. Observed host/runtime process-tree
RSS is 71.55 MiB initially, 63.78 MiB finally and 78.13 MiB at peak. The baseline
also completes 30 minutes (1,432 correct calls, 358 expected rejections). Author
guests differ in these endurance runs; they are correctness/lifetime checks,
not a paired throughput or memory-performance comparison.

The broad browser suite has a pre-existing Monokai hover-contrast failure:
4.3187 versus 4.5 in unchanged Floe 0.87.2 Button styles. The threshold remains
unchanged; the same 27/28 result is reproduced with published ReDevPlugin 3.14
and the same Floe 0.87.2. Full legacy Desktop I/O smoke is not certified: its old SDK fixture
fails compilation, and a current-SDK experiment reaches explicit loopback
connector denial. Redeven has no private-network approval adapter; 3.14 has the
same restriction. The Linux trusted-bridge readiness probe also receives 401.
Do not add permissive networking or claim these runs passed. Any private-network
feature requires a separate product-policy/UI design on the released upstream
connection contract.

No Store pool, persistent native cache, wider SQLite pool or four-surface cap is
introduced: measurements do not justify their complexity. Production phase
tracing is not shipped as a new public contract. This qualification does not
claim arbitrary native-library, shell, WASI or browser-sandbox escape support.

## Release/install
Same tag, independent install/upgrade; protocol/capability decides compatibility. Reject dirty source,extra/missing/link/mismatched files/target/tag/digest; both targets share commit. Extract verified signed bytes into new version directory. Target needs no compiler/Electron/Runtime. Compose uses package/exact.env and retains state/settings. Runtime installer excludes Center.

Pinned Node/Desktop package manager/Go/public deps build via build_center.sh <new-directory> [version]; default dev,production requires tag. Cross-build is insufficient without target execution.

concepts.title: Gateway v6 independent device protocol
concepts.summary: Gateway v6, authority epoch 70, defines independent client-device trust and Runtime attachments. The public protocol and private host API are separate surfaces on the same service, with independently verified device access and host authority. Cloud machine management and publication are absent.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Identities and wire fields
The stable gateway_id is independent of Desktop connection_id. RuntimeAttachment uses attachment_id and attachment_version. Catalogs contain attachments; Gateway metadata contains endpoints and tls_root_pem shared by clients and Runtimes. Device identities are not user memberships. Internal package/file names do not add a Cloud or user authority.

Client public routes are pairing/challenge, pairing/complete, identity, catalog, access/open and access/service under /gateway/v6. Runtime-owned routes use /v6/attachment for invitation-exchange, join, cancel-join, update-endpoints, rotate, leave and connect. Current attachment certificate/version and signed Runtime service identity are required.

Host-only routes issue invitations/client codes, list/revoke devices, update addresses/network/egress policy, remove or reevaluate attachments and query operation results. They are not registered on the public listener. ManageAttachments and ManageNetwork are request capabilities from verified host context, never device roles. Host proof grants both together; network settings, shared endpoint edits and attachment egress reevaluation consistently check ManageNetwork. Client trust administration requires current private host proof. OpenAPI declares each route surface explicitly. This alignment changes no route or signed payload, so protocol v6, epoch 70 and attachment schema 6 remain unchanged. Trust schema 4 retires historical host classification without replacing identities. Private host authentication is independent of device access; supplied signatures must still verify and address proofs retain their requested binding audience.

## Freshness and state
Runtime metadata versions do not gate attachment admission. Wire/authority mismatches fail explicitly; no old protocol translator or Cloud fallback is installed. Schema 6 attachment state rejects unsupported input unchanged. Expected attachment and policy versions fence relevant mutations; operation IDs recover known results and preserve uncertainty.

Daily/manual CodeQL skips unchanged main only after successful scheduled scan; lookup failure scans. Review source/locks; dismissals need exact authority/input evidence. Unavailable/nonzero is not clean. Actions pins/Node24 are separate from product Node.

## Build
go.mod owns exact Go patch, .node-version first-party Node; gates/engines/README agree. Desktop allows Electron/esbuild lifecycle only; ignores electron-winstaller for internal NSIS. Dependency changes regenerate notices. README locales preserve structure/terms/hash; images have actual Runtime/shared provenance/localized alt. Build UI before Go embeds. Env checkout lock covers cleanup/typecheck/Vite/budgets/compression; worktrees independent. build_assets cannot compress unlocked/missing output. ## Qualification/security
History workflow opens copied immutable released-writer fixtures via public API/restart; release needs same-commit pass, ordinary checks validate provenance. [Upgrade](../ai/flower-upgrade-compatibility.md) owns retention. Use fresh canonical headless carriers per [dependency contract](../architecture/env-app-upstream-web-dependencies.md); Floe tests use real client/browser except declared boundaries. Preserve geometry/after-paint focus; PDF drag restores temporary scale.

[Desktop lifecycle](../desktop/desktop-test-lifecycle.md) owns isolated preload/session/work paths and exact process-group/Windows-tree cleanup. External SIGKILL fails. Pinned Electron AMFI/signal failures are environmental: never resign or change trust/deps. Internal Windows qualification uses exact origin/main, Linux Runtime/two owned WSL distros and install/Start/Bridge/external-stop/Retry/Update/exact Stop before unsigned NSIS; unregister only owned distros.

Computer proxy allows fixed Responses POST only; terminal TLS exceptions require isolated CA. Bounded one-line diagnostics/synthetic data/quoted SSH grant no authority. Secret scan skips dependency caches, not native/product build files.

Center shares tag but installs separately: native Linux amd64/arm64 static binaries, exact identity/UI/licenses/templates/same-commit digest receipts. Missing/mismatch blocks collector; checksums/readback include both. [Deployment](../operations/web-center-deployment.md) owns operation; tags/CI prove no soak/device acceptance.

DMG Accepted/stapled precedes receipt/feed; App ticket/distribution policy pass. Stable emits two signed non-delta appcasts/notes, deletes temporary keys. Prerelease omits feeds and collector rejects them. Linux feed matches target. Installer/feed/notes join signed inventory/readback; [installer](self-contained-installer.md) owns activation/promotion.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Publication
Use go.mod/Env lock coordinated version. Boundary scan rejects sibling/Go workspace/replace/npm links/copied runtimes-contracts/Rust paths/duplicate platform-core, excluding generated/dependency output and failing on scan errors. No committed plugin package/parallel catalog. Validated latest-only market chooses immutable transport; platform verifies, metadata grants no trust.

Exactly one platform-release-manifest.json binds tag/source/workflow/attestation. Independently verify Go proxy/SumDB h1/go.mod, two npm SHA512/provenance, runtime/worker crates checksums/Cargo VCS, manifest version/closed coordinate order/contract-set hash. Extra/partial/local/mutable/mismatched publication fails before construction.

Manifest uses verified HTTPS/redirects: initial+three network retries including handshake;15s connect/60s transfer/120s retry-start (last transfer may finish later). Exhaustion deletes partials and stops before Rust with release-specific error. Validation never retries. --manifest-file validates identically offline. Node CLI emits validation evidence on canonical/symlink paths; empty success invalid.

## Native artifacts
Build Linux/Darwin amd64/arm64 from exact published crate/packaged lock/Rust1.98.0; no alternative first-party paths. Check target/tools first. Warm caches avoid servers. Transient install retry default3/max5; integrity/signature/manifest stop. REDEVEN_RUSTUP_OFFLINE=1 restricts Rustup cache, not manifest/Cargo validation. Honor Cargo/Rustup/proxies; no probe auto-install/TLS weakening. Recheck installs, preserve exact Cargo. Download120s/backoff2,4s cap60s; cancel stops/cleans diagnostics.

Linux static PIE has no interpreter/dynamic deps. Darwin exact native64-bit Mach-O receives Developer ID/hardening/timestamp before evidence; dev ad-hoc. The runtime alone carries exactly com.apple.security.cs.allow-unsigned-executable-memory=true for Wasmtime executable pages. Keep hardened runtime and library validation; do not grant the exception to Desktop shell or plugin documents. Staging and macOS consumption verify the signed entitlement dictionary and hardened flag, not just the source plist. Development Cargo cache identity includes signing profile and verifier bytes. Emit binary/SPDX/resolved provenance/notices/signature/certificate. Release Sigstore binds tag workflow; ephemeral Ed25519 fails --require-release. Cosign3 flags --new-bundle-format=false/--use-signing-config=false retain workflow/OIDC/transparency checks.

redeven.redevplugin_runtime_build.v1 binds publication/product files/target/tools/source/workflow/signer. Consumption rechecks descriptor/target/profile/signature. Startup uses expected marker digest, never self-hashed trust. Runtime archive exactly Redeven/ReDevPlugin runtime/six evidence files/license/notices.

## Desktop/collector
Before .bundle/<target> replacement validate name/closed flat inventory/Go target/native policy. Gateway separate; full evidence beside Redeven. macOS exclusion matches only independently signed runtime; preserve its bytes/evidence while Redeven/Computer/Sparkle/bridge remain signable. After Electron assembly copy full Computer resources/licenses. Validate startup before signing and after refreshing only signer-visited Runtime/Computer descriptors, just before outer seal.

Inspect final DEB/RPM/read-only DMG; emit v2 installer-bound runtime/six-file receipts. Upload installers/receipts/latest-linux*.yml only. Apple tools/system text suffice without rg; consume full pipefail pipelines. Require Team/signature/hardening/updater key/staple/distribution; Sparkle lipo places binary before -verify_arch. Linux relink source/object archives separate. Derive epoch/windows from reviewed contract, normalize feeds before signed inventory.

DEB: POSIX ustar/GNU regular files/directories,bounded long names,metadata-only root. RPM disables build-id symlinks. Bounded no-follow snapshots reject noncanonical/duplicate paths, links/devices,privileged modes,sparse/PAX,malformed trailers/trailing bytes/oversize.

Collector requires four Runtime/Gateway,four Desktop,two Center directories. Exact inventory:four Redeven/four Gateway archives,two DEBs/two RPMs/two DMGs,six receipts/identical shared metadata and two Center archives/receipts per [CI](ci-and-release-gates.md). Open once no-follow,hash/copy same descriptor,check inode/metadata,fsync/link without replacement; delete partial output on failure.

Internal Windows managed_wsl_archive binds one Linux amd64 archive to version/source/size/digest and rejects redeven.exe. Formal collector rejects all Windows until signing/update certification, never optional fifth target.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Trust and acquisition
The HTTPS bootstrap is the initial trust boundary. Its reviewed fixed digest authenticates the installer before execution. Upstream Cosign Blob API verifies exact repository workflow, OIDC issuer and tag through authenticated TUF roots, certificate transparency and Rekor. Accept detached .sig plus PEM/base 64 PEM only; no format guessing, mutable trust overrides, disabled verification or fabricated markers. Signature/digest failure never executes Runtime.

TUF requests are cancellable/time-bounded without writing user trust cache. Bound log responses before SDK parsing and admit detached X.509 hashedrekord/0.0.1 only; reject OpenPGP-capable/other types before the general parser. Pass unchanged bytes to upstream cryptographic checks.

Default installation resolves GitHub latest unless an exact version is supplied. Explicit managed channel uses the public version manifest and GitHub-first sources; self-upgrade environment semantics remain. Automatic resolution cannot downgrade a known version; explicit rollback can.

## Activation transaction
A no-follow nonblocking lock serializes the root. Closed bounded archive membership rejects links, duplicates, traversal, missing/extra files, bad trailers and changed bytes. Published artifact-cache owns verified acquisition/storage.

Stage complete suites in .redeven-runtime-suites/<archive-sha256>, sync, read back digests/inventory/version and prepare pinned ripgrep before atomic redeven symlink replacement. Ripgrep 15.2.0 uses Linux musl archives on both architectures. New/reused executables must actually run and report that version; missing loader, timeout, wrong version or oversized output leaves prior activation unchanged. Detect concurrent changes; restore and verify prior entry after post-switch failure. Distinguish unchanged from committed-but-unconfirmed errors.

Retain published suites and legacy flat resources: live older processes can still need them after multiple upgrades. Installer owns no process lifetime, so removal needs an explicit unused/rollback assessment; disk usage grows with distinct archives.

Fresh install uses a writable user directory without implicit sudo. Idempotent bash/zsh/fish blocks update future PATH; print the current-shell command or direct path for unknown shells. Upgrade changes no shell profile and starts/restarts no service. Runtime owns maintenance/re-exec after success.

## Publication and promotion
From v0.13.13, authenticated redeven-installer-contract.json declares minimum installer, closed targets and archive contract; older installers stop before incompatible acquisition. Render GitHub and Portal bootstraps from one template and four actual installer hashes; sign both through aggregate checksums. Portal uses its official mirror fallback, not another implementation.

Publish assets with --latest=false. Before promotion, check-distribution authenticates inventory/contract and each bootstrap's complete digest, tag, channel and four pins without relying on the current default. After promotion, --check-active-entry requires GitHub byte equality; Portal authenticates its active bootstrap against its own signed release and candidate minimum installer, permitting an older recommended Runtime. Read back GitHub's default independently.

README selects generated GitHub bootstrap; The Portal UI and install endpoint redirect to the generated Portal entry under its channel contract. Redirects confer no signature trust. No placeholder hashes/missing assets may activate. Public deployment is explicit. Rollback selects compatible immutable signed releases, never obsolete external-tool installers or duplicated shell code. Historical upgrade/native execution/page integration remain explicit acceptance, outside ordinary push gates.

## Dependency security
Consume checksum-verified published Cosign/Rekor patches. Require go-jose >=4.1.6 and no imported legacy golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp packages; preserve identity, signing time, roots and transparency. Qualify official releases plus tampering/cross-tag denial. The distinct general SDK OpenPGP finding and its format-rejection boundary remain documented below; a nonzero scanner is never a clean audit.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:

The bootstrap cannot defend against compromise of its original HTTPS script.
Cross-compilation alone does not certify execution on every target OS.

The dependency audit fixes the reviewed gRPC findings by selecting released
`v1.83.1`. The general SDK still imports the deprecated OpenPGP implementation
reported by `GO-2026-5932`; symbol scanning can continue to report it. The
installer rejects those input formats before SDK parsing. Do not describe a
nonzero scanner result as a clean audit, add a blanket suppression, or remove
this boundary without reviewing the upstream replacement and genuine fixtures.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Identity and trust
The user explicitly creates a device CA with `local-authority device-ca generate` and inspects it with `status`. Runtime startup never generates, replaces, or repairs certificate material.

Public export contains certificate material only, never the key.

## Explicit certificate changes
`import`, `regenerate`, and `remove` require `--confirm`. Reject malformed or extraneous PEM blocks, trailing text, encrypted/mismatched keys, invalid dates, invalid chains, missing SANs, and certificates unsuitable for server authentication.

This supports process-interruption recovery; it does not promise an OS trust rollback or filesystem power-loss durability.

## Coverage during network changes
[Local UI network exposure](local-ui-network-exposure.md) owns the two-second interface refresh and atomic public snapshot.

A signing failure retains only current addresses covered by the previous valid leaf and reports `certificate_refresh_failed`; retries recover automatically. Startup and explicit saved-identity preflight retain their strict validation boundary.

## Desktop interaction and private input
The compact HTTPS panel presents certificate validity, expiry, and system trust separately. Public path, fingerprint, and bounded selectable diagnostics live in the expandable details section.

Saving next-start HTTPS settings remains possible with an unusable certificate, with an explicit startup warning.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## HTTPS certificate ownership
[Local UI certificates](local-ui-certificates.md) owns creation, import, replacement, removal, validation, and client trust. It never creates or repairs certificate material, installs trust, or falls back to HTTP. Certificate replacement affects the next start; the running TLS identity and sessions remain intact.

## Listener and origin boundary
The public listener accepts only canonical authorities derived from its actual bound addresses.
An HTTP loopback listener also routes the exact plugin child origins derived
from its current parent authority and port exclusively to ReDevPlugin's Web
resource handler. Child routing strips parent credentials and never enters
Local UI management. A removed parent, different port, network-only address,
or HTTPS listener cannot use this loopback resource route. The platform still
validates each asset session, origin, ticket, and surface lifetime.

Its isolated `flowersec-private-loopback/1` profile is unchanged and cannot authorize public clients.

## Native Desktop default-port recovery
Only native Desktop launches with saved default `localhost:23998` and no explicit one-start bind override opt in through `--local-ui-default-port-fallback`. Other errors, custom ports, numeric loopback overrides, network binds, and wildcard binds never silently select another port.

External bookmarks containing the old fixed port cannot follow the temporary address.

## Network changes and current reports
While network exposure is enabled, Runtime enumerates eligible interfaces every two seconds. Its public list is explicit, including `[]`; private bridge endpoints cannot supply missing public addresses.

Address failures affect public availability and never assert that the Runtime process has stopped or expose private management URLs.

## Admission and lifecycle
A network listener starts only for a concrete non-loopback IP or wildcard with a fixed nonzero port and an effective password.

Occupied explicit ports fail with a startup error instead of silently selecting another port.

Flowersec owns admission, session establishment, liveness, handler dispatch, close, and lease release; Redeven does not copy those loops.

## Server-owned access configuration
[Runtime two-factor authentication](runtime-two-factor-authentication.md) owns the persistent credential authority, one-time bcrypt verifier migration, TOTP enrollment, recovery, replay protection, and ordinary-session revocation. Explicit password changes remain next-start settings when MFA is disabled; MFA-enabled settings cannot clear/replace that password or downgrade HTTPS.

Failed catalog saves roll back verifier initialization as well as replacement and clearing.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Mechanism
The local permission policy is a three-bit read/write/execute cap.

Explicitly configured read-only roots remain read-only; session caps, canonical path boundaries, and host filesystem permissions still constrain every operation.

Redeven persists only product authorization audit and does not maintain an approval queue, receipt, generation, revision, or recovery lifecycle.

## Descriptor-based reads

Repository-rule discovery and delivered-file reads use Registry.OpenRead. It
resolves current policy, rechecks the selected root, walks canonical components
through pinned os.Root handles, rejects substituted symlinks and compares opened
identities before returning a descriptor. Metadata comes from that descriptor.
A previously authorized pathname is not a reusable read capability.

Browser state, display-only Home hints, provider metadata, and UI affordances cannot widen runtime permissions.

Provider wire configuration may enable multi-call generation, but it cannot grant permission, bypass approval, or alter runtime scheduling.

concepts.title: Plugin platform integration security
concepts.summary: ReDevPlugin accepts authenticated host identity and source policy, never browser-claimed trust. HTTP checks auth/origin/CSRF/action; direct calls check owner/action/resource. Provenance, signatures, execution approval, update eligibility and permissions remain independent and fail closed on identity or scope mismatch.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Sessions and permissions
process.local is an explicit high-risk grant, rechecked by method on every Worker Process Broker call. Hosts inherit neither the complete Redeven environment nor session cookies/plugin tokens/credentials. [Process sessions](../architecture/plugin-process-sessions.md) owns lifecycle.

Resolve only stored channel metadata with exact nonempty channel/user/environment identities. Cache by owner-session hash; all four hashes must match. No guessed owner sweeps or local teardown registries.

Canonical HTTP route: /_redevplugin/api/plugins. Resolve method effects before local policy clamps; shared runtime management stays admin-only. Plugin Center reads grants and explicit policies via released APIs, never registry writes/default catalog grants. Catalog identity is not permission; only verified catalog trust receives Official, without changing actual trust badges.

## Package and network admission
Install/update requires exact source policy, revocation evidence, publisher/plugin/version, signed release metadata, package hashes and Host requirement. Reject browser trust, arbitrary bytes, rollback, unknown publishers, invalid/revoked signatures and fabricated provenance. Retain existing official release-ref verification; add no authorization workflow.

VPN/proxy/enterprise DNS is routing, not evidence of malice. Package downloads retain source/redirect/integrity checks through normal host routing. Authorized HTTPS connectors use released transport after grants; routing grants no extra destinations/methods, private-prefix bypass or ambient credentials. Proxy discovery/timeouts/TLS failures reject only their operation. Construction performs no discovery; plugin readiness cannot gate core Runtime. Keep TLS validation; proxy credentials stay on that hop. Never retry writes with unknown outcomes.

## Confirmation and runtime trust
Validate capability preflight against the Host-known response schema before confirmation. Reserved redevplugin.capability.risk_plan.* values must satisfy strict v1: reject unknown/malformed reserved versions without generic fallback. Replacement/replay needs new confirmation.

Descriptors bind version/target/IPC/WASM ABI/artifact hash. Darwin Developer ID signing precedes product digest/Sigstore evidence; Desktop signing preserves those nested bytes. Startup cannot trust a digest computed from its own field binary.

Business adapters run only after platform lifecycle/permission/confirmation/lease/quota/revocation/audit resolution. Never expose raw errors, tokens/secrets/cookies/query strings/absolute paths/full URLs in public or durable diagnostics.

## Web isolation
Plugin documents use distinct product origins and the published surface handler. Local UI/AppServer strip parent auth before delegation. Desktop binds private bridge credentials to actual frame origin. Frame-less workers instead require Electron's initiator origin in the owning Runtime partition, matching the exact private origin; missing/opaque origins fail. Present frames remain authoritative. Workers inherit no frame-only host-access/Tessiven claims. Center binds child routes to authenticated parents and cancels preparation on revocation; Gateway checks expected namespace/target.

Plugin DOM/rendering freedom grants no product-session/filesystem/process/credential/management authority. Released platform owns asset sessions/bridge/permissions/revocation.

Main-process session.fetch also enters Electron's hook. Contextless other requests retain authorization only with exactly one already-present matching private bridge token from the owning Runtime session and no frame/WebContents/initiator. Missing provenance grants nothing; destination must still be the exact private origin. Renderer/worker provenance remains authoritative; never inherit frame-only claims.

sections.body: Desktop control tokens, direct sessions, Gateway/RCPP credentials and Flower grants are not ambient plugin authority. Redeven adapters may narrow authority, never mint platform tokens, weaken routes, edit opaque state or replace released brokers.

concepts.title: Runtime access sessions
concepts.summary: Runtime accessgate alone owns validity/revocation. Valid sessions survive tabs/refresh/disconnect; cookie names isolate protocols/ports without extra authority. Expiry/logout/security/restart needs login. Invalid/incompatible clients fail closed; MFA owns credential recovery.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Session authority and lifetime
The gate alone decides channel authorization when registering the channel and its lifetime cancellation callback under one lock. Callers supply verified private-management identity or an ordinary login session ID, never an `unlocked` assertion.

Runtime restart clears in-memory sessions and incomplete operations; it preserves committed authentication state.

EnvAppShell binds remote access readiness to the exact connected client after access.status/access.resume succeeds. Each replacement channel must confirm access independently; late success or failure from a retired channel cannot authorize or disconnect its replacement. Protected Terminal catalog loading consumes this readiness, never transport connectivity alone. Local transport retains its Runtime-authorized channel admission contract.

## Browser Cookie scope and continuity
Local UI alone issues, reads and clears `redeven_local_access_<http|https>_<port>`. Forwarded headers cannot select the scope.

Only an incorrect password or factor produces input validation feedback; transport failures and cooldowns retain their own messages.

## Desktop consumption and forwarding
Desktop Flower retains the complete Runtime-issued access-cookie `name=value` pair and returns it unchanged. It never derives the name from a bridge or forwarded client port.

No upstream platform capability changes are required for this product authentication policy.

sections.title: Contract

## Enrollment and management
Desktop Environment Settings / Access presents one two-factor row. If a different environment password has been saved for the next start, restart before configuring MFA; the old running verifier cannot overwrite the newer saved authority.

These commands do not alter SSH keys, sshd policy, PAM, host passwords, or execution identity.

## Session authority
[Runtime access sessions](runtime-access-sessions.md) owns ordinary session deadlines, browser Cookie scope and refresh continuity, challenge binding, native editor delegation, and revocation. MFA management changes revoke ordinary authority through that single gate; they do not create a second browser or Desktop authentication lifecycle.

## Persistence, replay and recovery
`access-auth.sqlite` is a versioned, private SQLite authority, separate from the transport authorization database. The committed database and initialized key become the sole authority; deletion, malformed data, unsafe modes, symlinks, unknown schema, or key loss cannot fall back to the retired verifier.

Authentication state and secrets are not diagnostic export inputs.

Owner redeven-center setup --state-root issues a mandatory15-minute credential. Password/verified TOTP/recovery-code confirmation commit atomically; partial setup grants nothing. Passwords:12–72 UTF-8 bytes; recovery codes replace only factor.

Unix socket checks service UID/root, never SSH/tunnel/loopback/header claims. recover fences business and authorizes setup; recover --offline --origin needs stopped exclusive state. Unsupported peer checks fail.

Exclusive lock protects AES-GCM SQLite. center.key pins instance/origin/initialization; missing/corrupt committed state fails. Back up key/database together. DTOs omit secrets/private keys; only owner commands print temporary credentials. Audit keeps closed sensitive-action categories, never payload/credential-derived digest. Expiring challenges/grants alone bind exact actions; bcrypt verifies passwords. Schema2 atomically redacts v1 audit refs before readiness, preserving events/unrelated state; damaged/future stores stay unchanged.

## Authentication
Password creates a five-minute browser/action/session/revision challenge, <=five factor failures; password alone grants nothing. Atomic TOTP-step/recovery consumption survives restart. Login rotates device/browser sessions; security changes revoke sessions/challenges/grants/connections.

Limit16 devices, one-hour idle/twelve-hour absolute sessions. Only trusted visible input renews idle, never frozen pages/output/polls/heartbeat. Revocation preserves other devices; restart invalidates sessions but retains credentials/directory/audit.

Sensitive changes need fresh password/factor and ten-minute action/target/payload/revision grants. Password-change bindings use PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256,600000 iterations/32 bytes, domain-separated random login-device-ID salt, mirrored in Web Crypto; no raw-password SHA256. Recheck expiry/revision/session after derivation. Bounded same-session/request receipts prevent repeated effects. Viewing/opening valid sessions needs no extra MFA.

## Admission
Bound auth concurrency and persist administrator/direct-peer budgets through restart. Failures back off/expire, never permanently lock. Forwarded headers cannot select identity. Revocation/recovery cancels catalog/pairing; limits2/device/source,8/device,32 global preserve logout/other sources.

Limits:16 Gateways,128 routes,128 receipts (<=32/device),16 live root/child operations/device; concurrent proxy16/access-owner,48/device,192 total. Reopening cannot monopolize receipts. Revoke live admission immediately; five-minute tombstones retain outcomes. Bound JSON/headers, stream files, restrict egress to signed approved endpoints.

Child reopen makes fresh browser handoff and reuses authority only for exact parent/resource-kind/ID/Runtime-instance/login-cookie-name/value; paths may vary within resource. Cancel/expire repeated handoff preserves existing owner; owner revoke invalidates pending reuse. Reuse consumes bounded receipts and cannot bypass resource limits.

## Persistence and authentication
The Runtime opens apps/filesystem/directory-favorites.sqlite through sqliteutil before service readiness and closes it with Code App. Schema v1 is initialized transactionally; existing tables, objects and records are verified and unsupported or future schemas fail before a writable open.

There is no ten-item cap, automatic deletion, move tracking, grouping or custom naming.

## Client ownership and interaction
One in-memory client per authenticated environment supplies every mounted entry.

Initial load failure offers retry; refresh failure retains displayed paths.

No separate title card, second path line or persistent favorite star occupies the sidebar.

Files composes Home, Computer and favorites into one Quick access list, deduplicated by absolute path with authoritative root labels and permissions preserved. All entries share filtering and scrolling; roots are not pinned separately. Short lists use their natural height, capped at the smaller of 16rem and 45% of the sidebar body. The directory tree owns a separate viewport. Filtering appears above five entries, matches labels or full paths, holds the viewport height while active, and restores the previous list scroll on clear. Refresh retains rows, focus and the query. Arrow/Home/End navigation reveals only the local target, including in scaled Workbench windows. Menu invocation retains the captured directory and published focus ownership.

Quick access marks only the exact active destination, never its containing root. The existing navigator supplies pending intent: selection and busy semantics update immediately; the progress icon appears only after 150ms of uninterrupted waiting to avoid fast-refresh flicker. Current-page semantics identify only the displayed path. Hover is weaker than selection; a leading marker distinguishes selection from focus. Selection never changes font weight, size or text geometry. Filtering never promotes another row to active.

The entire 32px-high shortcut row is a native navigation button, including padding and permission badges, except for the separate trailing 32px menu button. No dead gaps or overlapping actions divide these targets; pointer, keyboard and touch retain the same navigation/menu ownership.

Published Sidebar owns the outer width; the Files/Git body fits its content box without a second fixed width or outer scroll owner.

Flower exposes favorites inside its directory picker. Conversation transcript and thread-list menus do not mutate directory favorites; their directory actions follow [working directory navigation](flower-working-directory-navigation.md).

Runtime compatibility epoch 69 requires this exact authenticated resource and Desktop route allowlist. Floret APIs, domain schema, conversation lifecycle, file-operation authorization and Runtime Service protocol version remain unchanged.

sections.body:
## Title bar and reading space
Activity uses published Floe FloatingWindow.titleContent/WindowTabs for multiple documents and headerActions for the active document. One file keeps the ordinary title; two or more replace only the title area with scrollable, closable tabs. Tab selection never drags or maximizes the window. Unused header space, including the trailing reserved grip area, inactive feedback slot and action separators, moves the window; only actual controls own their pointer input. Floe uses physical titlebar event ownership so per-document actions portaled into the header retain the same blank-space behavior. Labels cannot select text. Pointer sorting keeps the original opaque tab face under the pointer with a quiet shadow, smoothly shifts neighbors and settles into its new slot without an insertion bar or external focus border. Host order changes only on release; cancellation restores the original order. Reduced-motion preferences remove settling animation; Alt+Shift+Left/Right offers keyboard sorting. Escape cancels sorting before window dismissal. Reordering preserves selection and panel DOM order, including live iframe documents. Keyboard focus stays visible inside the tab face. Arrow/Home/End navigation and Delete close remain local; long names truncate and full paths appear as tooltips. Only Ask Flower, More actions and fixed window controls remain in the floating header. More actions owns Copy path, Edit, Save, Discard and Download with their existing availability, selection and feedback. No separate path row; Copy still copies the active full path with success feedback.

The Activity preview workspace owns one controller and retained panel per normalized file path. Every filesystem entry point uses this owner; opening an existing path selects its tab without re-reading or discarding changes. Switching preserves editor drafts, renderer nodes, reading position and preview mode; inactive native audio/video pauses. Each tab retains its own actions, load/retry state and error. Close an inactive tab without changing the active one; closing the active tab selects the adjacent survivor. Last-tab close dismisses the window. Window close confirms all unsaved documents together, and cancellation leaves every draft intact. Saving blocks confirmed discard until it settles. Accepted dismissal fences pending reads and releases retained resources after Floe exit presence.

Flower message/attachment floating previews retain their own source-identity tabs through the same upstream header component in both hosts. Source loaders remain independent, repeated opens select the existing source, and close/retirement aborts reads and releases object URLs. Failed attachment loads expose an independent Retry action. Snapshot inspectors and Workbench canvas widgets retain their separate ownership; modal conversation-file navigation retains its existing back-to-list flow.

## Workbench reading space and narrow widgets
Workbench exposes the full path through tooltip/Copy and begins content beneath its header, except existing sync notices. Keyboard/Escape/Tab/focus behavior cannot trigger canvas gestures or reclaim focus through the shell.

## One action implementation
`FilePreviewActions` owns availability/feedback. Header actions preserve reading selection; the product download builder keeps current file/draft mapping.

## PDF drafts and persistence
Writable PDFs expose Edit file. PDF.js saves full Unicode values; unsupported original fonts use `NeedAppearances` instead of embedded replacement fonts. Downloads always use the product manager, including conversation-file child previews; [conversation file ownership](../ai/flower-task-files.md#downloads) defines background lifetime and toolbar history.

## Unavailable targets and recovery
Navigation opens current filesystem objects; historical tool/diff/image snapshots retain original content. Failed targets offer Retry/Open parent. [Dismissal](file-preview-dismissal.md) owns resource lifetime and close semantics.

## Absolute paths and runtime authority
Released Floe DirectoryPicker/DirectoryInput/file pickers own navigation/validity/request lifetime. Redeven supplies connection, authoritative path context, i18n/form state. [Filesystem policy](../security/permission-policy-and-filesystem-scope.md) reauthorizes operations; Home/Root/context never invent grants.

## Navigation state and failures
Each picker owns directory/entries/input/hidden switch/validity. Fence stale success/failure by current intent; validation is no later authorization. ## Live language changes
Translate Home/Root in place without replacing drafts/selection or reloading authority; Desktop/Env App share the adapter.

## Product presentations
A failed Files navigation retains its last readable listing and one dismissible notice:selectable full path, copy, recovery actions. Without a readable listing use a bounded recovery card. Paths wrap/controls reflow inside scaled/narrow views. Link input to this notice by ID; syntax/cancellation retain own explanation. Editing clears stale invalid-input state, not unresolved navigation. Retry keeps focus/geometry through pending/repeated failure.

Existing browse/cache owner shows only visited target's snapshot while verifying. Uncached targets preserve readable listing with separate pending intent. Current clicks do not reload; pending duplicates share a request. Unverified cached destinations still verify/commit. Superseded reads release queue immediately and cannot alter content/persistence/recovery. Manual/hidden-path changes verify first.

Reveal each changed tree destination once per visible container; revalidation cannot repeat scrollIntoView or undo user scroll. Pointer navigation keeps row anchor; selection typography/geometry never transitions.

## Creating a child directory
Released picker owns New folder and nonmodal anchored popup:parent, name, actions, focus, Enter/Escape, pending/stale-request handling. No extra backdrop/resize. Escape/Cancel/outside idle closes popup only. Failure retains name/local error. One authenticated callback serves Flower, DirectoryInput/Env adapters. Names are one child, not traversal/nested paths. Env App uses nonrecursive filesystem RPC/invalidation; Desktop exact POST /_redeven_proxy/api/fs/mkdir. Both share filesystem/scope/Git mutation owners. Require session write, strict fields, existing parent and preserve existing entries. No recursive creation, synthetic list or automatic retry. Unknown effects require inspection. All ten locales translate errors. Compatibility epoch 70 requires the Desktop resource; older peers upgrade. Gateway/Floret/schema unchanged.

[Favorites](directory-favorites.md) owns scoped persistence/refresh/failures; shortcut views cannot confirm an old selection.

## Companion ownership
Published `BottomBarCompanion` owns geometry, viewport/safe-area clamps, motion, outside dismissal, Escape and mount handling. Its Portal uses the explicit Activity overlay host, never `document.body`. The collapsed field is centered; bounded detail grows upward without changing body geometry. Running work cannot prevent collapse or destination interaction.

Desktop Activity Terminal supplies a 24-pixel anchor in its 28-pixel footer, centered in the terminal column with a shrinkable 360-pixel maximum width. Workbench/mobile terminals supply none. Terminal supplies its reactive background/foreground alongside the anchor. Only the collapsed footer entry uses that palette: a restrained tinted surface, visible border and monochrome Flower icon. Expanded Flower keeps the shell theme; palette changes never replace its editor. Placement does not create another Flower instance, alter transport or route Flower input through the terminal.

## Stable Flower placement
After first access readiness, one retained `EnvAIPage`/`FlowerSurface` moves among explicit hosts. Visibility drives `hidden`, `aria-hidden` and `inert` together. Available unfiltered Workbench placement survives deselection; canvas selection governs input/focus only. [Settings](flower-setup-and-settings.md#retained-panels) own retained panels/forms.

New companion conversations may capture the desktop Activity origin using its read-only page reader. [Turn launcher](flower-turn-launcher.md) owns sending/context actions.

## Presence and summary
[Presence](flower-companion-presence.md) owns collapsed priority, live tails, completion feedback, composer precedence and workspace observation.

## Dismissal, focus, and reads
Outside capture includes shell, anchor and classified Flower-owned Portals. Trusted cross-origin plugin bridge events join host pointer/focus dismissal without consuming the destination. Shared SSE summaries are activity-only; initial/reconnect read baselines and later read envelopes are scoped to the same `UserPublicID`.

sections.body:
## Content and identity
Permanent folding gutter aligns prose/activity/progress/Goal before grouping. Details align with summary; tool/thinking metadata follows text with compact gap/full-row activation. Chevrons derive right/down solely from aria-expanded, including initially open screenshots.

Identity=thread/run/turn/canonical item. [Sequences](flower-tool-sequences.md) groups tools/thinking; individual details stay accessible. Collapsed fields preserve intent/result shape without hidden payload. Disclosure reads selected values:16KiB chunks/128KiB windows with selection pins. Close/hide/navigation cancels. Markdown keeps exact UTF-8/whitespace, yields between batches, and retains complete selected working set rather than fixed preview.

Thread Query:/Thread Read: remain technical labels with model intent in user language; [queries](../ai/flower-thread-queries.md) owns privacy/limits/failures. Web search uses one localized visible/accessibility title; details show actual per-call results/errors, including URL-only sources, without repeated query/URL/pattern/status.

Registered/hosted/source/MCP/unknown tools share compact glyphs/leading edge with prose/progress. Composer/status shares native scrollbar gutter. Existing resize observer reads only inline-size changes; existing layout scheduler publishes changed geometry. Row growth adds no width reads/observers/schedulers; embedded hosts retain ownership. Collapsed titles describe intent, never supply input/authority. Computer tools omit absent-observation filler but retain typed failures, uncertainty, blank pages and unavailable targets.

Authorized Activity source rows preserve exact host-authored text without path guessing; Floret v7.105.0 retains credential protection. Redacted/invalid_utf8_replaced/truncated facts have separate localized notices. Historical altered content is not reconstructed. Computer completed_reads describes requested scope independently of current snapshot authority; context reset and failed operation index stay visible in details. Structured result rows retain validated invalidation scope/event/frame, interrupted-wait measurements, and completed read identities; these facts do not authorize retries or establish application readiness.

## Observation interruptions
TARGET_OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE keeps canonical error/completed actions, but visible/accessibility copy says page read unavailable, distinguishing confirmed effects. Unknown effects/user decisions retain attention. Keyboard technical disclosure keeps original message/code. Published ActivityError.Code and bounded computer_observation=unavailable chips retain category without hidden-body reads. Exclude these interruptions from group/turn failure counts; confirmed time/operation budget exhaustion uses neutral completed-work-retained copy with canonical diagnostics. Permission/unknown-effect failures retain attention; other errors stay failures. Never infer old records from English, rewrite history, mark recovered from unrelated success or auto-retry.

## Viewport/input
One controller owns position; layout/focus/motion/growth cannot resume paused reading. [Sequence geometry](flower-tool-sequences.md#geometry-and-input) owns native nested scroll/inert controls; [SubAgents](flower-subagent-detail.md) owns child viewport.

Prose continuously approaches actual bottom; chunks retarget without restart. One line settles≈160ms with fractional positions/no overshoot. Share one geometry frame; motion-only frames reuse measurements and skip history scans until settled scroll. No idle polling/delayed output. Native input/selection pauses immediately; clearing selection does not resume. Initial positioning/navigation/resize/shrink are immediate. Explicit latest arrives220ms; automatic folds follow real content without trailing space/competing scroll. Exclude paused insertion room from latest distance. Reduced motion skips; hide/rebind/dispose cancels.

## Thinking and motion
Canonical first/last chunk receipts survive hydration/reconnect/restart/Fork. Continuation reopens interval, last chunk ends it. Tooltip distinguishes receipt vs compute; show<1ms/localized Not recorded, never infer neighbors/totals. Legacy observations remain memory-only.

Live petals fill clockwise then center, hold/fade2.4s. Sealed/canceled/disconnected static; CSS handles theme/reduced-motion/high-contrast/forced colors without lifecycle. Disclosure uses one reversible Web Animation,180ms open/140ms close, stale completions ignored. [Sequence handoff](flower-tool-sequences.md#disclosure-and-bodies) owns260ms geometry/crossfade/stationary prose.

Fresh tool/argument/thinking titles reveal once168–360ms,<=32 width-adapted steps; full text/geometry/accessibility/actions exist immediately. After sequence placement, make viewport room220ms before reveal; growth retargets without extending deadline. Scroll interrupts, paused reading remains; reduced motion skips. Delivery/results/controls never wait. Independent arrivals/shimmer preserve typography.

Accepted receipt/selection provenance gates execution arrivals. History/body restore/queued reads consume claims and settle statically; post-ready live snapshots/deltas qualify. Two visible receipts retain only restore revision/live flag, no copy/scheduler/timer/row observer. Claims exclude navigation/reconnect/hidden disclosure/>450ms delayed mounts; observe closure before lazy mount and survive preview promotion/remount/replacement/completion. Final snapshots may reveal new tools from previously active execution.

Auto-fold awaits admitted title motion then reading protection. New prose awaits sequence close; manual actions/delivery immediate. Title node survives trigger change, call identity transfers remaining time. Failure/approval immediate. Navigation/dispose/hide/reduced motion clears clipping; no character timers/per-frame reactive state/durable animation facts.

The shared Flower UI bundles 27 common website marks from pinned theSVG assets with audited per-icon licenses. Icon enhancement runs independently after Markdown rendering; collapse/expand never restarts it.

The renderer receives image bytes, never a third-party tracking URL.

Assistant Markdown can already contain an explicit bibliography inside an unlabelled, `text` or `plaintext` fence. This is display-only authored content: it neither fabricates canonical source annotations nor binds numeric prose references to provider metadata. User messages and fetched external Markdown do not enable this assistant-specific presentation.

Settings recovery stays inside the collapsed row, with a reachable Retry and unchanged height. It replaces compact summary copy until recovery; active Stop remains available. The published shell cannot clip recovery outside its bounds. Expanded recovery uses the existing floating notice stack.

## Retained editor and explicit entry

One shell grows upward/outward in width and height, preserving bottom edge, border, background and clipping. Close dissolves detail before compact layout; reversal follows current phase. Exit keeps fixed coordinates and Activity height, without origin flashes. Published forced-color and focus indicators remain. Composer disclosures follow [shared surface material](surface-material.md): portaled nested menus retain More ownership, Escape returns focus one level at a time, and exits stop accepting input immediately. Use the shared workspace SSE; summaries cannot invent personal read state. Expansion requests current selected detail without a second stream; disconnect uses existing recovery.

## Composer precedence
One derived entry owns rendering/target, in this order:
1. Current-thread pending decision, regardless of question type or draft.
2. Ordinary editor for draft, attachment, reference, focus or IME; inspection if editing unavailable.
3. Eligible running, queued, unread-failure or ephemeral-completion target button.
4. Ordinary editor or read-only/unavailable inspection.

Adapters serialize captured patches and load latest revision; the store atomically merges with compare-and-set. Stale writes return 409 without auto-retry. Captured target/model identity fences late responses against navigation or retargeting.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Baseline/ownership
ThreadFactsSource carries body-free workspace/account/Computer facts. Root/child windows independent; one worker coalesces<=64 dirty parents without blocking facts. [Adapter](../ai/floret-redeven-adapter-and-projection.md) authorizes. Register before freezing navigation-ordered roots; emit Ready,<=25-summary pages,baseline_complete,private states. Facts wait; accepted reads bypass sidebar prep. Cancel drains budgets/queues without Next. Broken observation invalidates, never skips pinned roots.

Merge pages immediately; prune only after completion, preserving creation/selection. [Startup](../architecture/flower-startup-presentation.md) admits first page,confirmed empty or selected detail,never partial Ready. HTTP refresh25-row pages/10s per progressing page retains partial success. Desktop cancels history/item POST. Baseline precedes shared loading; coalesce demand except command confirmation. Navigation/dispose/transport cancels waiters; reconnect keeps content/draft/scroll.

## Windows
Root/child revisions fence replacements; baseline/delta share subscription. Initial50 items/1KiB preview/Activity summary/existing byte cap. Paging150 items/512KiB; POST64KiB JSON/150IDs; locator8KiB; exact membership448KiB previews excluding hydrated bodies. Viewer/current-only events grant no coverage.

Charge max(transmitted, window_bytes). Receipts refresh accepted intervals without forcing Latest. Retain confirmed sealed bodies and mounted visible/focused/selected live islands; evict inactive documents whole. Prefetch near missing intervals. One explicit input demand owns handoff, including stationary/folded edges; layout/HTTP cannot traverse. Anchors guide placement, never admission. Folded summaries remain reading anchors through canonical header relocation. Prepending and sealed-body completion preserve their screen position before paint. An upward wheel at an unloaded edge retains only its clamped distance; the same scroll owner applies that distance as bounded motion after insertion, subtracting any native movement. Only the animation-frame callback advances retained wheel motion; body/resize layout flushes repair geometry without advancing the input clock again. Reverse input, disclosure, navigation and Latest cancel it; reduced motion applies the bounded distance immediately. A short latest tail cannot resume following from an immovable downward gesture. Native downward scrolling resumes following only at the actual tail (one-pixel rounding tolerance), never by snapping across the near-bottom margin. Canonical folded navigation may prepare adjacent pages within the existing prefetch margin; it never moves the reader across all those summaries. Failures retain draft/content with Retry.

Collapsed turns/sequences install public navigation/retained rows in one observer. Canonical membership resolves same-turn/run skips without host hidden scans. Only intermediate prose may skip; active/unknown/trailing/approval/input/unsafe facts bound it. Finite accepted IDs prevent repeat skips; scroll/expand reaches gaps. [Sequence proofs](flower-tool-sequences.md#membership-and-counts) avoid duplicate summaries; HTTP/observer share proof without body/extra observer reads. Keyed gaps update affected rows. Disclosure cancels navigation/restores interest/retires demand; new input starts fresh.

Foreground pages may publish during baseline queue. Reuse sealed prefix only with exact ID/kind/turn/run/ordinal/canonicalOrdinal; stale windows prove no ends. Preserve focused/selected/disclosed DOM. Align receipts with<=one preview page/displayed span; other gaps stay demand. Sequence owns counts/unknown labels. Patch summaries show real mutation/type or localized count, retaining totals/files on expand. Activity keeps bounded shape/scalars; fields read frozen authorized source.

## Bodies and transport
Retain accepted prose/media/anchors/follow during refresh. Unread historical text keeps its canonical preview in the same bubble, with stable pending status from first mount; never insert a synthetic fixed-height skeleton. Stage sealed body chunks until complete, then correct the reading anchor after synchronous Markdown rendering and before the next frame. While reading inside a preview, retain the visible paragraph/table row through Markdown DOM replacement using its message identity and element position. Horizontal table overflow does not own vertical reading. Only a clipped trailing text fragment or empty message margin may defer to the next visible message. Disposed messages cannot correct a later viewport. One observer admits within 160 px. Text/disclosure share two slots/15 s, prioritizing live/interactive, visible, then background with aging every eight admissions. Offscreen/navigation cancels; errors expose Retry.

ThreadCache binds item/turn/run/source. Text chunks<=16KiB at accepted UTF-8 offsets; coalesce growth/yield batches. Visibility owner survives complete extents; finished reads detach parent cancel listeners without aborting. Offscreen/navigation/source changes cancel. No poll/full-prefix download. Source/seal change restarts canonical preview while retaining readable content; same-source progress survives refresh and late replies reject. Retired locator source_changed releases slot, awaits authoritative ItemBody, never guesses offsets. Terminal/exhausted Retry does not replay.

Canonical final/intermediate membership is validated by Floret against full content. An empty or whitespace-only bounded preview remains valid when its exact content source matches the item, optional run matches, UTF-8 preview length matches, and safe integer extent proves unread bytes. Cached body hydration, source growth and same-source replacement keep preview_bytes equal to the retained UTF-8 prefix length. Do not infer empty canonical content from a prefix. Missing/duplicate/wrong-kind/wrong-execution/out-of-order references still stop application atomically; typed diagnostics record only field/reason categories, never payloads or source identities.

live:false alone does not change source. Same-source previews atomically update text/pending/locator; overlap retains layout and suffix resumes at current offset. Changed source retires reads; identity/range/prefix/empty-nonterminal failures stay explicit.

Schema3 has one decoder. Base64 fragments<=32KiB carry ID/index/count/total/exact scope/revision/contiguous version-UTF8 offsets. Constant-storage coalescing retains original base/semantics. Bound16 pending batches,32MiB envelope/subscriber and32MiB global refs. Started frames immutable; byte-accounted coverage suppresses duplicates. Separate summary/private/child mailboxes. Pending controls use authorized64-item pages to user boundary, check leaf/version and individually read oversized items, never full View/body. Broken authority/sequence invalidates.

## DOM/retention
Offscreen sections keep DOM/height; live/visible/focused/selected accessible. Partition active turns near24 rows after prose, preserving groups/owners. Keyed subscriptions dispose with owners. Thread identity only replaces; fields reactive. Equal replacement/empty preview retains membership; matching tools reproject. Unchanged tokens/entries/coverage reuse summaries. Structural facts avoid field observers; titles never rescan; thinking retains block; presence tracks emptiness; empty coverage ignores leaf; follow scans no old anchors.

[Activity](flower-activity-interaction.md) owns inspection/before-paint scroll; Fork inherits no disclosure. Body/readiness cannot alter restoration provenance or unrelated motion; full baseline/hydration admits history. Stage cold sealed Markdown through reconnect, reveal final geometry without entrance. Navigation suppresses arrival until placed. Count cache objects once without reactive recursion. Current run/visible anchors guide compaction; paging restores decorations.

Inactive cache12 threads/32MiB estimated protects selected/retained/in-flight/summary owners. Recount retained bytes only when an eviction candidate exists; baseline replacement and leaving a displayed/retained document invalidate its estimate before the next eviction decision. A sole displayed document never incurs a full-body census on live baselines. Append logs256chunks/256KiB use absolute cursors/exact-source catchup; active documents/selection uncapped. Catchup notice waits200ms, publication never waits. [Composer](flower-turn-launcher.md) owns captured-input DOM before confirmation.

## Recovery
Detail/baseline backoff200/600/1200ms,<=4 attempts/15s. Revision retires unpublished state; leaf drift recovers,foreign/malformed stops. Navigation/dispose/connection cancels. Exhaustion retains content/draft/DOM/scroll with interrupted-sync Retry,not command replay. history_invalidated allows one bounded read/selection-manual intent,then Retry. Release cancels immediately; child only its slot,one-shot inherits none.

Transport/handshake/gap keeps backoff; dispose cannot publish,reconnect publishes boundary. Observer follows DOM lifetime. Auth/capacity/version/malformed stops; classified transport may retry,mapper exceptions never. Diagnostics preserve category/status/epoch and SSE503/baseline504/invalid400/capacity429. Unknown effects retain request keys.

A centered floating stack above the companion shows interrupted live updates, Resync and minimizable details without moving content or occupying headers. Minimize preserves its horizontal center. Shared Button and floating presence own control feedback and entry/exit; detail expansion uses a bounded transition, chevron and inert hidden controls. Reduced motion removes animation; forced colors retain borders/focus. Busy Resync shows progress and coalesces repeated activation. Without transcript content, the same notice exposes its explanation immediately; it never implies that the underlying task paused. Escape/outside dismisses without stealing focus; targets >=44 px. The owner coalesces reconnect. Restored requires current connection/selected authoritative detail, not optional collapsed reads. Dismiss after 2.6 s unless focused/hovered/expanded. Preserve drafts/selection/bounds. Canonical cancellation owns Stopping; viewer facts grant no coverage. [Approvals](flower-approval-context.md), [read state](flower-read-state.md) and [turn disclosure](flower-turn-process-disclosure.md) retain policy.

A timed-out Stop confirmation retains an actionable Resync button once its read settles; awaiting canonical confirmation must not leave that explicit recovery action busy indefinitely. Initial synchronization notices may finish their exit transition after readiness.

concepts.summary: Shared Flower uses Floe colors for compact reading and contrasting sent-message selection. Themes change paint without disturbing DOM/geometry/selection. Queue stays quieter; forced colors use system roles. Media/cards preserve identity without empty message bubbles.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Transcript reading scale
Assistant/user text uses `0.875rem` and unitless `1.75` line height. Composer controls retain published control scale.

## Assistant reading roles
Body/headings retain the chat foreground. Presentation does not rewrite Markdown or infer metadata from authored bold text, dates, identifiers or citations. [Citations](flower-citations.md) own destinations/copy.

## Filled messages and content
Sent text/answered-question receipts mix 4% theme foreground into the published `floe-well-on-plane` fill for clearer separation from the content canvas, with `floe-radius-group` corners and 16px horizontal padding. Reading ink derives from the theme foreground with stronger light/dark luminance; ordinary text, full questions and answers share that ink and the transcript reading scale. Across published presets and both materials, body ink clears 7:1 and is no weaker than assistant ink on the same capsule surface. Only status/redacted metadata is secondary. Queued input retains its separate paint and spacing.

Answered receipts retain every complete question followed by its answer in canonical order, without disclosure or choices. Questions use regular weight, answers medium weight, and a quiet check accompanies the localized status. Spacing and thin neutral separators distinguish multiple responses. Short receipts fit their content without a minimum-width panel.

Text, placeholders and actions share the right edge; the full-row history wrapper makes the 78% desktop bubble limit relative to the transcript. Short text fits intrinsically; narrow views retain the full-column limit. Error/code insets use readable foreground and selection roles over their own backgrounds.

## Queued input beside the composer
The shared Flower component owns queue presentation in both hosts, using published Floe theme roles. A queue is a borderless, shadowless list of 32px single-line rows with a quiet neutral fill, 2px between rows and 4px above the composer. Long labels retain their complete text through truncation and the native tooltip. The list scrolls at the smaller of 10rem or 30% of viewport height. Host styles must not duplicate the retired queue-panel layout.

Drag, edit, send-now, delete and attachment/reference previews retain their existing authority and behavior. Action hit areas remain at least 24px, reserve their width and reveal on hover or keyboard focus; touch controls remain visible. Focus, pending feedback and stream updates must not move neighboring controls.

## User media and resources
Order is image thumbnails, wrapping resource cards, text bubble, then timestamp/copy. Resource/image-only messages omit empty bubbles. Canonical previews use exact thread/turn/reference identity; queued actions retain their separate authority/click guard.

## Native text selection
Filled text, including transparent table headers, reverses capsule ink and fill for visible native selection; code and queued insets retain their own selection roles. Selection never changes parsing, copying or transport. Browser checks require 4.5:1 supporting/selected text and a visible selection surface across all presets/materials. Copying answered receipts retains complete ordered questions/answers and the localized hidden-answer placeholder. [Highlighting](flower-code-highlighting.md) retains its own stable-content contract.

concepts.title: Flower model and navigation presentation
concepts.summary: Flower separates Desktop/environment sources, unavailable models and first setup. Thread-owned model/reasoning choices remain authoritative. Navigation distinguishes visual intent from committed content and fences stale reads. Transient action failures use notifications; canonical failures remain in their timeline.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Mechanism
The composer always keeps its model label visible without an availability spinner or busy status.

Runtime status distinguishes no Desktop provider (`not_configured`), configured but unavailable keys or catalog (`missing_keys` or `empty`), and actual connection or protocol errors.

## Model identity and recovery
Thread snapshots, list items, and patches carry `model_id` and `reasoning_selection` as thread defaults. The last is a disabled, ungrouped display of a thread's missing model; Flower never silently replaces it.

See [reasoning selection ownership](flower-reasoning-selection.md) for loading, draft, and submission rules.

## Web search presentation
Model choices display the shared search badge from the server's readonly `web_search` projection. A provider brand or frontend model name never enables search. See [model directory ownership](../ai/model-directory-and-selection.md).

## Permission and navigation
Below the 768px viewport breakpoint, the composer keeps permission status and selection in its own More panel, alongside any other overflow controls.

Saving disables only the permission control, prevents duplicate requests, merges the authoritative settings response, and restores the confirmed value on failure.

Warm sessions switch without provider or transcript remount and stale loads cannot replace the current thread.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Flower does not treat the global model or permission as an existing-Thread launch override. After creation, its `model_id`, `reasoning_selection`, and `permission_type` are authoritative; Thread changes write to its settings, while new-thread overrides stay connection-local and never update environment defaults.

The header switcher is only a product-specific compact presentation; it does not create a second selected-thread owner or change the requested, committed, and content-presented ordering.

concepts.title: Flower received output progress
concepts.summary: Flower presents dispatched-request waiting/output and provisional edit line counts, then confirmed results. Published Floret v7.42.0 owns in-memory progress/preview lifecycle; Redeven interprets safe product-tool JSON. Presentation adds no journal records or schema changes.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Model request
Each logical request and attempt has its own start, first-output time, last semantic-progress time and estimated received output tokens. Local tools, approvals and user input never use this model-pause presentation.

Only phase text is a live region; numerical updates are readable without repeated automatic announcements.

## Indicator geometry
A live run indicator holds one width while it reports. Inside a host that gives it a bounded track, the mark and phase label keep a constant start inset, the token-and-clock metric keeps a constant end inset, and digits grow only in the free space between them. Reveal dots reserve their full width instead of animating it, so no tick resizes or recenters the indicator. The [subagent detail window](flower-subagent-detail-window.md) supplies that track in its footer rail.

## Progress symbol
The shared Flower mark retains its five-petal geometry.

The symbol is decorative beside the existing localized status text and does not create another live announcement or execution state.

## Edit arguments
The frozen tool definition supplies one optional argument preview parser per call. Their input budget is 1 MiB per call, with bounded JSON depth and field counts.

[Confirmed file Activity](flower-file-activity.md) remains the durable outcome.

concepts.summary: Floret owns canonical child reports/events and admission; UI owns pages/bodies/disclosure only. sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
The parent transcript merges messages, anchored decorations and events by published canonical_ordinal on the queried Path; received time is display-only. Published Floret v7.61.0 supplies optional parent_turn_id from canonical receipt order.

Event headers keep the received time directly after the source/status in one compact row. Long source names truncate within the available width, including narrow companion surfaces. Below 16rem of available inline space, headers reflow to preserve readable status and time with enlarged text. The source-name button is the only child-navigation action; report expansion stays independent. Preserve the default header row height for disclosure anchoring. Layout uses CSS without measurement listeners, polling or extra reads.

Explicit group expansion completes only its finite canonical receipt interval. Source notifications coalesce into the existing reader. A one-record frozen-leaf read validates ancestry before reusing settled non-interaction admission facts; unadmitted and all interaction receipts require status pages. A rejected old path triggers canonical interval replacement. Authorization and transport errors never establish ancestry. This avoids retransmitting an expanded settled archive on every source notification, without adding polling, subscriptions or a durable projection.

An isolated Service/SQLite/scripted-provider browser qualification exercises actual fork, detail and report JSON through the production adapter and FlowerSurface, including read failures and restart.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: [Subagent runtime](../ai/subagent-runtime.md) owns delivery, tool authorization and complete report reads. The timeline must not add an inbox, model-read receipt, transcript, lifecycle cache, or periodic refresh. It does not copy reports into model context; the canonical admission path does that at the next natural provider boundary.

## Account selection and recovery
The shared dialog offers ChatGPT account and API key methods. Selecting an entry never starts OAuth or saves a provider.

Account persistence, renewal and cancellation belong to the [account lifecycle](../ai/chatgpt-account-lifecycle.md); local admission belongs to the [authentication contract](../ai/chatgpt-local-authentication.md).

## Connection feedback and continuity
The connection panel groups account identity, state guidance, and actions. Background reads of known accounts never remount a loading picker. All stages use the shared Desktop and Env styles and explicit localized copy.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Connection setup
OpenAI offers API keys or verified local ChatGPT accounts. Registration and model selection stay independent; endpoints stay flat and permissions unchanged.

## Kimi
One Kimi choice offers API or Kimi Code. Drafts isolate keys, endpoints and models; close clears them. Switching rejects stale discovery. Saved methods stay fixed; add another connection to change service. Cards label methods; IDs, aliases, selections and history stay unchanged.

Use short names and access labels. Explain keys, quotas and saved methods in the access tooltip; model limits in the model tooltip. Icon links open official guidance. Code keeps regional endpoints and reviewed IDs; billing never falls back.

## Search and secrets
Provider and model search switches must both be on; preferences remain editable when provider search is off. Backend policies own availability. See [failure recovery](flower-failure-recovery.md). Stored keys use fixed dot placeholders. Null removes a key; omitted/blank patches preserve it. Catalog refresh never selects new models.

## DeepSeek Fetch
Omitted Fetch configuration uses direct GET fetching. DeepSeek Fetch is opt-in
inside the DeepSeek provider dialog. Explicit existing DeepSeek selections are
preserved; this does not disable the separate search capability. HTML Preview
is described as an available rendering capability without recommending its use.

concepts.title: Flower read state
concepts.summary: Redeven confirms reads per user from server version and actual local presentation. Old responses cannot restore already-cleared indicators; unseen activity stays unread. Temporary sync failures recover in background without blocking operations or inventing acknowledgements.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Flower read state is a Redeven-owned per-user activity watermark. A separate loaded-content revision prevents metadata or private confirmations from qualifying stale body content as current.

No storage format or historical watermark is reset.

Neither a detail response nor a hidden measuring transcript qualifies as
presentation. Selection telemetry and read acknowledgement wait until the
[destination presentation boundary](flower-thread-selection.md) releases its
prepared viewport, then retain the existing visible-document and content-revision
checks.

Foreground visibility is an input, not a second asynchronous readiness lifecycle.
The selected detail loader and destination presentation boundary own readiness;
returning to the foreground only requests their existing coalesced refresh.
Navigation, reselect, canceled reads and failed refreshes must not strand a
surface-wide readiness flag or prevent another presented thread from confirming
its content revision. Hidden, covered, loading and failed content remains
unacknowledged through the presentation checks themselves.

This boundary adds no polling, detail payload, list refresh, or backend storage.
Acknowledgements retain one in-flight request per thread, monotonic confirmation
and the existing retry policy. Repeated presentation of the same confirmed
revision sends no additional acknowledgement.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: Read confirmation belongs to Redeven product state, not Floret execution or shared lifecycle summaries. The existing database and migrations remain authoritative. No additional read-specific interaction or transport is introduced.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Loading, reconnecting and rendering never write reasoning preferences. Explicit new-thread Off survives shared remounts/attachment preparation; a confirmed non-reasoning model clears unsupported draft intent.

[Preferences](flower-conversation-preferences.md) own explicit full-model-identity choices and budgets. Sending/automatic normalization cannot save them; preference failure reports separately without rolling back confirmed thread settings or changing retry snapshots. One localized ordered option list serves all controls; explicit Default remains distinct.

| Capability | Control |
| --- | --- |
| Boolean | Default, supported Off, On |
| Named efforts | Default, supported Off, declared levels only |
| Token budget | Bounded input; clearing removes override |
| Fixed thinking | Noninteractive Always on |
| Unknown thinking controls | Noninteractive Model controlled with explanation |
| No reasoning | No control |
