concepts.title: Flower setup and settings
concepts.summary: Shared setup/settings serve both Flower carriers. Unconfigured profiles offer setup; configured new chats offer editable starters without launching. Retained modal preserves saves/errors and makes covered chat inert without read acknowledgement; existing model/permission/recovery owns policy.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## First-time setup
Welcome setup requires no selected thread, configured provider or usable model, and absent/`not_configured`/`empty` Desktop source. Desktop `local_host` opens the current surface's settings, never another Welcome window or a remote destination. Artwork has no glow or continuous animation.

The unconfigured surface is one open, canvas-level composition using published Floe ink and Button interaction, with no card, icon tile, heavy heading or filled call-to-action. It contains the Flower mark, setup title, one short explanation and the available settings destinations. Local setup has one text action; remote Desktop setup keeps distinct Desktop and environment text actions with concise localized labels. No model-sync control or starter-task previews appear before configuration. Existing settings updates restore the retained composer and draft when a model becomes usable; configured-model recovery remains in its existing settings/menu owner.

## Starter tasks
Four editable drafts cover current-folder understanding, connected computer, installed applications and folder organization. Names/dates alone never justify deletion. The [companion](flower-activity-companion.md) omits the grid.

## Settings composition
Settings edit the environment profile even with a Desktop model source. Flat sections preserve identity/drafts. Immediate switches block duplicate edits and roll back on failure.

## Provider configuration
[Provider configuration](flower-provider-configuration.md) owns authentication, layout and connection-before-model sequencing.

## Retained panels
FlowerSurface retains chat/extensions and a lazily loaded settings form in a bounded scrollable modal. Covered chat/navigation remain inert through close and do not acknowledge reads. Settings interactions belong to the companion: dialog close keeps it expanded; host collapse closes both while retaining form/progress/errors.

## Saving and ownership
Independent adapter operations save permission, model profile and default model. Permission uses a serialized 700 ms coalescing controller, fences older responses and restores the last confirmed value on failure. Computer-use failures restore the confirmed switch and expose errors.

sections.body:

Permission descriptions sit outside the single-line selection buttons and are linked through accessible descriptions; arrow-key selection and autosave retain their existing owner.

concepts.title: Flower streaming stability
concepts.summary: Indexed ThreadCache and published incremental Markdown apply actor-native changes only to affected text/DOM. Preserve history, code color, copy, focus, selection and disclosure. Semantic changes stay visible; malformed updates recover through the single live-state owner without suppressing output or adding lifecycle.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Incremental owners
Indexed item/message records initialize from snapshots. Text/extent growth preserves window/turn/decoration identity; only structural changes recompute relevant metadata. Argument previews update one block, never completed tools. Validate counters and retire stale/withdrawn attempts. Real removal restores adjacent-action/composer focus unless navigation moved it. Tests require zero historical ordinal reads for 20 appends across 100/10,000 archived items.

Structural scans read immutable source identities without opening every retained store proxy. Cached rows keep their reactive message owner; plain snapshots cannot supply live getters. Prompt history observes user content and status only. Activity counts follow replaced block identity. Sequence placement touches changed membership and registrations, preserving borrowed row owners, focus, selection and prepend anchors. Following-tail inspection checks interaction blockers without measuring historical rows; immediate disclosure settlement performs no unused geometry reads.

Process rows reuse immutable block classification; final/intermediate membership, live status and turn outcomes remain current. Computer candidates subscribe only to relevant target references. Observed-window turn identity stays separate from the complete reading document: wire-only replacements neither rebuild archived membership nor rescan historical ordinals. Actual ownership, ordering, coverage and lifecycle changes still publish atomically.

Already canonical timeline order needs only a linear order check; out-of-order receipts/decorations retain stable canonical sorting and uncommitted tail order. Unchanged tool groups and history partitions compare their existing source range before allocating copies. Sparse keyed facts visit source keys when fewer than mounted subscribers, avoiding repeated broadcasts of absence; changes and removal still publish synchronously. Regressions cover 2,400 ordered rows/100 retained partitions, reversed input, uncommitted decoration anchors, 600 sparse-fact subscribers and 600 retained groups plus one appended group.

Viewport binding reads no offsets or extents during DOM mutation. Initial nested-tail placement and disclosure callbacks join the existing before-paint layout pass; explicit reopening restores following intent, while transferred reading anchors retain their offset. Native input captures its starting offset before the browser default action so deferred measurement cannot erase wheel movement.

Same-run authoritative snapshots retain the thread presentation store and equal collections. Replacing the observed runtime window must not rebind every retained row's layout controller. A new execution retains the existing canonical-prefix checks and gets its own presentation. Structural message changes still invalidate membership; content-only advancement stays on its existing text owner.

History-gap measurement runs after accepted membership, inside the same publication batch while old rows remain mounted. Only removed interior rows contribute new gap height; preserved/appended membership performs no historical row geometry reads. Existing gap geometry and virtual anchors remain authoritative. Live process classification cannot collapse a running turn, so inspection protection runs when folding becomes possible; terminal selection/focus/manual disclosure checks stay intact. Standalone row registration does not enumerate unchanged sequence projections.

Published createIncrementalMarkdownParser owns Marked/CJK/GFM. reset installs full baseline, append changes regions and finish corrects complete content. Changed snapshots reset because token offsets/identity can move; reuse only exact tokens/offsets. Same-source metadata preserves regions. Completion/collapse/replacement retains every authored block. [Highlighting](flower-code-highlighting.md), [diagrams](markdown-diagrams.md) and [media](flower-inline-media.md) retain their owners.

## Text and layout
New prose fades to currentColor over 320 ms via 20 fixed CSS highlight phases, without node splitting, line movement or delivery delay. History/corrections are immediate; links/code/media keep colors. No stylesheet changes, computed-style reads or per-frame inline writes. Limit 32 transient groups/owner and diff inspection to 8,192 characters/128 nodes per region; larger changes appear immediately. Completion settles valid effects; reset/disposal/hidden/reduced-motion/forced-color clears them. Published hot drag/resize also settles ink immediately while text, selection and DOM remain live; only post-release additions animate. Historical/unsupported-API owners schedule nothing.

Cold historical bodies stage until complete, retaining offset/staging through reconnect; expose final Markdown geometry without height motion. Sample table/code/list/text from first visible frame. Existing prose/live output remain incremental. Font measurements use disposable completion/error listeners, not detached FontFaceSet.ready retention. Companion reads newest relevant record plus bounded Unicode tail.

## Queue and measurements
One ordered frame queue atomically applies envelopes in reactive batches. Cooperative 4 ms budget includes reactive work and yields between envelopes, never preempts one expensive envelope. Capture failures inside batch so recovery commits before rethrow to connection owner. Ready waits for drain; other reads pause at 16 frames/1 MiB. Epoch/failure/disposal releases readers and fences late callbacks.

Coalesce only contiguous one-item appends with exact thread/item/turn/run/reading revision and same attempt facts except time/monotonic progress. Keep semantic boundaries/clears; join once preserving UTF-8/version. Gaps reject whole pending batch and report one sync error. Growth bounds: 64 frames/4 MiB/250 ms, 75 ms during drag/resize. Semantic timer may replace stalled rAF but never overtake growth. One valid 32 MiB wire envelope plus reserve is allowed with backpressure. Diagnostics omit content; the slowest envelope records only timing, kind and structural counts to distinguish baseline replacement from ordinary item growth. Copy success feedback lasts 1.6 s; denial is never success.

Explicit real-Service qualifier freezes history/provider cadence and measures production Runtime/Electron CPU, allocation, wire, frame/input/click/output. After timing, real disclosure controls compare all prose/thinking against canonical content. [Long-thread](../operations/flower-long-thread-gate.md) adds sustained growth/floating input; both stay outside unified gates. Synthetic task CPU/heap/allocation/decoded queue samples mutate state only after timing and cannot certify providers/encryption or peak memory.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
The parent header replaces the numeric robot badge with at most three circular canonical portraits and a separate `+N` remainder.

Single-target operations place the compact portrait/name capsule beside the action title. A deferred target field reserves the same line from its summary, before action or identity reads finish. Loading and read failures stay in that slot; long names truncate without wrapping. Touch targets and enlarged fonts retain stable row geometry. Creation failures retain their error details.

The existing field reader remains the sole read owner. Header rendering adds no request, polling, measurement loop, or child-detail prefetch. Portraits use bundled SVG selected by canonical `thread_id`. An identity without authorized parent membership remains informational; only the existing parent inventory enables child navigation. Name-only targets use the same compact capsule without inventing a portrait or navigation identity, including deferred fields and creation failures. Creation titles contain only the action; the capsule owns the task name and its full tooltip.

[Subagent detail window](flower-subagent-detail-window.md) owns complete current-view reads, live replacement, Activity rendering, child navigation, and queued-input controls.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:
Flower must not recover a missing child identity from activity sidecars, a title, a delegated approval alias, a fallback thread id, or local state.

The dropdown lists tasks only. The empty trigger uses Floe's outline Workflow
icon; canonical portrait stacks remain for existing agents. Empty dropdowns use
a compact text row without an oversized illustration or placeholder card. The published
SurfaceAnchoredLayer owns measured placement, local surface boundaries and
viewport updates, with a six-pixel gap. Never position from an estimated menu
width. Shared floating presence retains entry/exit motion and disables exiting
content; shared overlay masking owns outside dismissal. Arrow/Home/End navigation
and Escape focus restoration remain product task-list semantics.

concepts.title: Flower subagent detail window
concepts.summary: Child windows read full canonical ThreadView through matching parent-child HTTP/live identities. Activity/queue controls stay attached to that child. Updates retain navigation and scroll; presentation neither copies transcript nor creates a second lifecycle authority.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
The detail GET returns exactly `{ summary, current }` and accepts no paging query. Child currents use the same bounded unsent-text coalescing and transient browser-frame rules as roots, described by [live current transport](flower-live-timeline.md).

The window stacks three in-flow regions: a facts band, the transcript region, and an optional run-progress footer. The footer is a sibling of the transcript region, never an overlay, so a live run indicator can neither cover message text nor change the transcript's measured top and height. The footer centers one fixed-width pill under the window's inline center; [received output progress](flower-output-progress.md) owns the pill's stability rules.

Floret remains the lifecycle owner described in [Subagent runtime](../ai/subagent-runtime.md).

sections.title: Boundaries

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Terminal facts
Floret owns the nested `ActivityItem.presentation` contract and merges results with their stable call presentation. Labels and descriptions are authoritative; the typed operation supplies localized fallback text.

The five-line independently scrolling output viewport retains its existing owner.

An omitted output field is pending content, never an empty canonical frame with a nonzero first sequence. Wait for small-field hydration before polling or installing its sequence; large fields use source-bound ranges, then acknowledge their watermark before adding process deltas. Existing output and selection survive handoff.

Published Floret v7.95.0 atomic activity reads own the bytes, sequence range, process identity and deferred source together. Flower never stamps a newer summary's range onto previously accepted bytes. Canonical activity status remains current independently. Check execution identity and range before publishing optional details; retain accepted output on failure. One in-flight read coalesces revisions; failure latches until explicit Retry, visibility reentry or connection change. Collapsed/offscreen rows do not read. No additional backend scan, transcript snapshot or transport contract is introduced.

Malformed process output stops its local poll and exposes a localized read-only Retry without raw diagnostics; other messages and stream observation continue. Canonical stream validation still fails at its existing connection boundary. Write acknowledgements never apply hidden output frames. Equal-watermark snapshots may fill an empty frame or extend its earlier coverage, but duplicate/older snapshots cannot replace a newer live suffix.

Inactive output caches have 200-entry / 8 MiB estimated-byte limits. Mounted outputs remain retained until release; frame metadata coalesces after 128 records without changing sequence checks. These cache limits do not truncate an active process output or its canonical history.

## Output, completion and restart
The model keeps four tools: terminal.exec/read/write/terminate. Read/write/terminate
descriptions are optional; read uses the last returned sequence. Each page is
bounded without an outer second truncation, and chunk boundaries preserve UTF-8.
The process retains at most 1 MB; gaps and invalid source encoding remain explicit.

Redeven binds the process identity to Floret before Start. Confirmed completion
seals bounded output and result facts through Floret, then supplies one bounded
notice at provider preparation or a natural idle continuation. Explicit final
reads suppress duplicate delivery. The original execution's model, tool scope,
reasoning and budgets are retained; cumulative budgets still apply per run.

Shutdown suspends new execution, reaps owned processes and persists observed
results before closing Floret. Abnormal exit preserves unknown outcomes without
replaying commands, resending stdin or adopting PIDs. Historical output reads
use authorized thread/process identity. Unknown observations stop UI polling;
readable sealed output remains paginated. Final Activity updates the original
item through Floret's canonical presentation sources.

## Interaction boundary
[Activity disclosure interaction](flower-activity-interaction.md) owns stable triggers, manual choices, animation, transcript following, and floating controls across all renderers. Approval state is never a row badge, chip, metadata line, title suffix, tooltip, detail, or ordinary activity ARIA label. Completing a decision removes that dock without inserting an approval outcome into history.

Floret v7.103.0 exposes unknown as a terminal Activity status and attention reason.
Flower preserves its count, keeps the row outside successful/active sequences,
uses a localized warning label, and retains readable historical output. The row
does not imply success or authorize command retries. An unknown observation is
not active polling work; available retained pages may still be read to completion.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Selection and navigation
Rail feedback precedes commit by two animation callbacks and a task; hidden documents skip frames. Latest intent supersedes prior work; summaries cannot bypass coordination. Reveal after required baseline/handoff, measurable layout and visible historical text settle. Cached windows renew bounded interest if needed; ready caches prepare immediately. Never await runtime quiet. Canceled reads cannot release newer selections.

One loader owns selection/reselect/reconnect/retry. Position transcript and active sequence after placement before reveal. Restored titles/groups/turns are static; folded turns cannot block readiness, and manual folds retain labels. No smooth initial positioning or timer fallback. One cancellable 200 ms feedback deadline spans detail/body/layout without delaying ready/error state. New chat/navigation/disposal cancels old feedback; frame/composer stay stable and body failures retry locally.

Cached destinations flush effects and use checkVisibility({contentVisibilityAuto:true}). ResizeObserver corrects above-viewport growth before paint; rAF/visibility handles reveal/body work. No polls/per-row observers. Explicit wheel/touch/scrollbar/keyboard pauses following through late reads; scroll events alone do not. Two slots prioritize visible/margin text and cancel obsolete demand; ThreadCache retains immutable bodies. Growth/refresh/completion preserves accepted prose/selection. [Live delivery](flower-live-timeline.md) owns validation/retry. Open Latest; reading restoration is separate. Sort by creation descending then ThreadID ascending.

## Continuous history and concurrent activity
Scrolling reads canonical windows automatically, retaining visible/selected/focused rows, details and anchors across live changes. A collapsed short tail retains trailing room during prepend; reclaim it only outside view or as content fills it. Resize preserves anchors; destination preparation clears temporary geometry. Attach content observation after mount and correct growth before paint, without new reads/state/disclosure changes.

Latest remains above the composer away from current tail, even at a historical window bottom; hide during preparation and preserve gesture protection. If tail is installed, smooth-scroll and retire trailing room at arrival. Otherwise cancel obsolete demand, install one bounded tail interest and reveal its prepared destination without walking pages. Root/child share this path.

Observer/reading revision own accepted baselines. Ordered delivery/deduplication cannot discard distinct baselines at equal canonical version; full-view watermarks cannot suppress reading baselines. Retire obsolete refresh markers without invalidating newer interest. Queue budgets remain unchanged.

Collapsed ranges use canonical skip-and-retain to reach prior dialogue. One explicit reading gesture continues across advancing folded-only pages until readable content appears or the canonical edge is reached. It does not require another gesture per failed/retry turn. Each page retains the existing item/byte budgets; no-progress, read failure, disclosure changes and superseding navigation stop continuation. Explicit disclosure shows cached rows immediately and completes only its sequence: one request/document, 40 records/page, finite forward horizon. No full-content button/replacement observer. Show one geometry-neutral indicator after 150 ms; cancellation hides it immediately and only failure exposes Retry. Disclosure changes cancel obsolete navigation; thread/child/Latest clears gap demand. Headers follow canonical order and transfer focus to earlier owners.

Tools/reports retain previews; disclosure reads authorized bodies through the existing owner. Collapse/navigation/disposal cancels unused demand; reconnect restores consumers. Empty activity sources use Floret defaults in source order. Canonical unknown tool outcomes remain readable with an explicit localized unknown label; they are never converted to success, retried, or rejected as malformed history. Ordinary history retains full expansion; demand pages use published Floret v7.91.0 source-backed summaries without enumerating all turn tools. Runtime document owns mutable live records/versions. No universal latency or expanded-output memory guarantee.

## Detail read ownership
Floret supplies canonical summaries/windows/body reads. ThreadCache owns selection/detail with twelve entries; one bounded coordinator shares navigation, command confirmation and reference preflight. Cancellation never reconnects the workspace stream.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Resizing
One 220–380 CSS-pixel preference owns desktop sidebar width. Inline resizing updates only its grid track, at most once per frame; drawer width applies only in overlay mode. Mobile, companion and embedded layouts keep their sizing.

One primary-pointer gesture retains the latest sample and settles on release, cancellation, lost capture, blur, layout change or unmount. Release listeners, frames and cursor/selection shielding; persist once per gesture or immediately for keyboard changes. Storage failure cannot interrupt interaction. Width changes cannot reparse Markdown or invalidate the full transcript.

## Rename from the conversation header
The header pencil edits the existing ThreadID, including during execution/loading, with canonical title prefilled and selected. Header/sidebar share one save owner and thread cache.

## Selection and detail reads
[Selection](flower-thread-selection.md) owns deferred commitment, bounded reads, cancellation and recovery. ThreadCache owns committed selection/detail; sidebar intent reserves feedback only.

## Reference action
Right-click, More and Shift+F10 share the ThreadID-owned menu. [References](flower-thread-references.md) own deduplication, preview, admission and recovery.

## Context menu response
Sidebar and transcript context menus are fully visible on the first frame, without an entrance transition. Use published Floe compact row/control tokens on desktop and retain 44px touch targets. The shared resize observer supplies the measured client border box to `SurfaceFloatingLayer`; Floe owns clamping and projected coordinates. Live action changes remeasure without replacing the menu or losing focus. Long paths remain truncated with the full path available on hover.

## Pending replies and approvals
Localized reply/approval labels appear beside the title with bounded status/progress width. Background updates use the workspace stream without selection.

## Pin ordering
The stable `.flower-thread-rows` owner contains inline size for real/skeleton rows; movable cards cannot be size containers. Keyboard order matches visible search/pin-overlay order. Failed pin operations undo only their own presentation and reconcile via the existing summary stream or one explicit command read.

## Stable presentation and convergence
Key rows by ThreadID and group labels separately. ThreadCache owns summaries; each batch publishes once under existing title/revision rules, preserving menus, focus and running-wave continuity.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Membership and counts
Group>=2 same-thread/turn/run nodes including a tool; thinking qualifies. Preserve canonical row/call/error/preview/output order. New singleton may settle prior work without overriding inspection. Thinking moves in place; first canonical node owns DOM, loaded anchor preserves disclosure through paging/navigation. Summary and accessible names omit thinking counts; thinking stays readable inside the group. Tool failures use concise localized counts (for example, `2 failed`).

Break on prose/users/interactions/compaction/approvals/non-tool errors/Goal updates; Goal/Web Search calls remain tools. Scoped SubAgent call/report/completion/running-attention/waits join; unknown parent/other waits break. Exact uncertain tool errors join with complete-coverage unconfirmed counts; invalid success-with-uncertainty or uncertain parent lifecycle breaks. Empty placeholders transparent, unknown text proves no continuity. Answered input splits even newest settled group.

[Typed observation interruptions](flower-activity-interaction.md#observation-interruptions) retain status/grouping without visible failure counts; unknown effects keep unconfirmed counts. Exact boundaries/item/events permit counts even in partial windows. Otherwise show only localized Consecutive tool calls/accessibility name, no partial total/latest/loading. Keep known failures; counts acquire no history/body. Paging preserves disclosure/focus/selection.

Sparse islands need accepted endpoint proofs from Floret or<=8 indexed reads/explicit baseline, sharing maximal results; streaming queries none. Hidden prose/compaction/interactions/unknown/active/unsafe/scope changes break proofs. Ephemeral metadata retains surviving endpoints. Expansion fills<=40 missing items/page without tail resampling/retained retransmission.

## Disclosure and bodies
Historical group/turn defaults settle statically before display, retaining explicit choices/eligibility. Only admitted live arrivals fold before prose after row placement; folded turns skip inner placement. Choices key Runtime/thread/tool through updates/reconnect/navigation until refresh. Focus/selection/gestures/details/away-from-tail protect expansion, never reopen closed groups; only explicit disclosure/navigation reopens. Observe per group.

Live fold260ms to summary height2rem desktop/2.75rem coarse, not zero. Summary fades last100ms after140ms; new prose remains mounted/inert/invisible then reveals opacity160ms. Delivery continues; existing/inspected/historical/navigation/reduced-motion prose never waits.

Finish titles first. Terminal outer turn owns motion/nested geometry; interrupted inner fold transfers painted opacity/transform. One pending map binds later prose to owner. Reversal awaits new motion; dispose/reduced motion releases. Measure once, no per-tool timer/observer/frame reactive state.

Closed groups mount shells/summary; first open mounts bodies, subsequent folds retain inert bodies. New closed members wait; whole-turn folds retain inspected bodies. Borrow/restore existing DOM at first-node viewport with focus/selection/state. Reproject only membership/status/disclosure/order. Sealed thinking reads only explicitly open/visible through clips, observing movable displayed node. Shared two-slot read queue prioritizes interaction/cancels obsolete/reuses text. Unopened tools mount/read no bodies.

## Progressive completion
Only explicit group/enclosing-turn opening that reveals open group completes boundaries; auto-live groups never traverse history. Before paint transfer anchors/focus/detail owners when first node changes. Reopen retains latest-tools destination.

Immutable pages never overwrite newer facts/bodies; mutable IDs join bounded tail observation. Fence by thread/connection/navigation/document. Collapse cancels demand but abort-ignoring transport holds physical slot until settlement. Sample finite tail once, never chase output. Empty exhausted boundaries finish; nonadvancing fails.15s exposes Retry without releasing unsettled slot. Parent receipts reuse interval events; no hidden terminal/thinking/report bodies.

## Geometry and input
Tool/thinking titles/summaries/times13px/18px. Prose/icons/summary/progress share edge; permanent gutters avoid shifts/blank titles, including children. Full-row targets put time/chevron after intrinsic text; only long text shrinks. CSS owns geometry, no text-measure loop.

One outer left native bracket/button collapses:24px target/44px coarse. Folded button covers summary/trailing chevron; stable crossfade prioritizes counts. Rail remains outside scroll body and stops before prose, no row connectors/hit-test loop. Rows2rem/2.75rem; sequence<=8rows/65% transcript; thinking<=20rem/45% window/transcript. Natural short height, thin scrollbars/localized keyboard remain.

Native scroll consumes local then chains at edges for thinking/sequences/read-only terminals/files/diffs/code. Upward wheel/touch/key pauses follow; actual bottom return resumes. Canceled/contained/zoom stays local; editors own input. Shared controller separates user/programmatic/geometry. Retain nested anchors. Explicit open positions latest tools before paint; navigation waits for row/destination. Restore static, manual folds closed. Complete counts may name latest without body read. Collapse focuses trigger; thinking retains offset/completion. [Activity motion](flower-activity-interaction.md#thinking-and-motion) coordinates arrival.

Expose viewport IDs/localized counts; folded members leave no gaps/ineligible headers. [Turn folding](flower-turn-process-disclosure.md) owns auto anchors; manual retains trigger. Both catalogs cover narrow/touch/focus/reduced-motion/forced colors.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
Core commands reject missing, duplicate, invalid or conflicting IDs; only the legacy RPC adapter may fill a missing one. [Goals](../ai/flower-goals.md) share the outbox. Empty-thread creation retains text/reference/attachment authority; first Send binds staged resources to the authorized canonical thread. Unknown effect outcomes are terminal with safe explanation and no replay action.

## Immediate send feedback
The immutable transport outbox owns submitted text, references and attachment
metadata before IndexedDB or HTTP completes. Ordinary sends render a pending
user row immediately and consume only the captured draft; newer edits stay in
the composer. Request-key message and section identities survive canonical
admission, including receipt/live ordering and prepended history. Images reserve
the same thumbnail geometry and use the authorized staged preview until admitted.
Failed and unknown outcomes retain the frozen request for explicit recovery;
server 5xx responses never prove rejection or authorize a fresh request identity.

Product admission uses published SendAck and narrow canonical summaries. HTTP
and RPC return admission identity without a post-commit history read; authorized
window observation supplies presentation separately. Agent preparation binds the
already persisted execution authority to the admitted turn. No duplicate
post-admission authority write or second conversation lifecycle is introduced.
Full model history remains an engine execution requirement, not a prerequisite
for painting the submitted message.

## Restored data and preserved inputs
New submissions capture storage generation immediately, even behind paused dispatch. Rejected input stays copyable/restorable; running it requires explicit new submission, never resumed old approvals/effects.

## Context preview presentation
One Env App `FlowerContextPreviewWindow` uses existing preview/text components for launcher and draft/canonical snapshots. Launcher owns attachment IO, sequencing and URL cleanup; Flower owns validity. Related-surface markers preserve input ownership; Escape dismisses preview before companion.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Facts and eligibility
Validated facts carry exact TurnID/RunID, optional control kind, start/end/outcome, work/wait/elapsed time, ordered intermediate/final IDs and complete-final boundary. Typed structure determines eligibility; summaries, prompts and time heuristics cannot trigger folds. Unknown prose stays visible.

Headers show lifecycle and total elapsed time including waits; terminal descriptions retain processing/wait durations. Show <=two nonzero units and subsecond copy. Thinking-only work keeps its own disclosure without a whole-turn toggle. Interleaved answers default open; settled question/answer receipts fold with process rows, retaining nested choices and viewport-contained decoration without folded rail/gap. Counts require complete boundaries/membership/events; otherwise omit. [Sequences](flower-tool-sequences.md) fold independently on either side.

## Ownership
From canonical admission, running/preparing/retrying/finalizing/waiting turns show a non-interactive header before provider output. Announce status politely, never elapsed ticks. Exact outcome/end enables the toggle and one automatic fold of confirmed process/intermediate rows, including latest failed/canceled/interrupted turns. Final/trailing partial output remains.

Focus, selection, gestures, open details/thinking and away-from-tail reading protect inspected work permanently against later observations. Capture an unaffected visible anchor when automatic folding starts. Explicit choices survive paging/reconnect/regrouping. Newly classified inspected rows stay until the next explicit toggle without opening siblings; only disclosure/navigation reopens groups. Retained folded bodies are inert with offsets/choices intact. Main/embedded/child views share rendering, not scroll owners.

## Placement and motion
Anchor the header after its loaded request or before the first loaded response, independently of fold membership. Keep request/header mounted during arrival. Intermediate membership spans same-turn runs; Engine owns supersession. Goals keep turn ownership; finals are run-scoped. Retained prefixes preserve confirmed facts; windows replace overlapping classification. Partial windows never fetch history for presentation. Prepending the beginning moves the header while retaining choice/focus; anchor visibility does not own disclosure.

Eligibility changes no header geometry. One-line status/time/detail slots use tabular digits, bounded widths and narrow overflow handling. Following folds align actual bottom before paint, without stale absolute offsets, synthetic trailing space or competing growth motion. Long-to-short content ends at zero with final visible. Finals remain mounted during the 260 ms fold; reduced motion is immediate. Manual/paused reading retains anchors and necessary insertion room, excluded from distance-to-latest. Input cancels follow; settlement cannot reclaim it.

Fresh visible live labels fade 0.68→1 over 180 ms; later changes 0.88→1 over 160 ms. The complete current label stays readable: no clipping, blank frames, overlapping text or character queue. Fast completion joins the active transition. One JSX text owner survives wrapper-to-button changes with node/timing intact; at most one bounded opacity animation. Accessibility, controls and geometry update immediately; ticks never restart motion. History/restoration/reconnect/urgent states/reduced motion are immediate. Hide, interaction or reduced motion settles animation.

When a turn ends while prose waits on an inner sequence, outer motion owns release and preserves nested geometry; interrupted inner folds transfer painted opacity/transform. Manual reversal retains choice/preferences. Canonical Path orders dialogue/receipts, never timestamps; preserve final segments and secret redaction.

## Elapsed time
Current-view server samples establish a browser monotonic anchor across same-turn waits/continuations. Missing sample means status-only: queue/browser wall time is not authority. Newer samples reanchor after sleep/reconnect; delayed samples cannot move live time backward. Canonical terminal time wins. Keep samples in bounded detail cache, out of summaries/wire fields/storage/events.

Only visible active headers subscribe to Surface's existing one-second clock. Offscreen/hidden/disconnected/terminal headers unsubscribe. Ticks change only the time label, never projections/counts/folding/network demand. Reconnect pauses ticking until existing transport confirmation; add no poll/request/payload/write.

## Outcome
Terminal labels use 13px/20px text and decorative 16px Floe warning/circled-stop/circled-alert for failure/cancel/interruption. Quiet color, first-row wrap alignment and localized labels preserve accessibility; diagnostics/recovery receive no duplicate outcome labels.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
[Directory selection](filesystem-picker-navigation.md) owns validation; this contract owns entry points and destinations.

## Header and new-conversation entry points
The full-page header has a borderless folder/name browse button; new-conversation welcome selects the draft directory without persistent full-path secondary text. Only picker confirmation remembers a validated real directory. Browsing, cancellation, suggestions and destination navigation never write it; created-thread directories remain immutable.

## Directory and menu ownership
Right-click captures its row's thread/directory without loading, selecting or acknowledging it. Updates cannot retarget actions; handled child events cannot open outer menus. Copy/cancel restores valid triggers without scrolling.

Conversation transcript and thread-list menus expose browsing, opening a terminal, and copying the working directory. They never expose directory Favorite or Unfavorite actions; thread pinning remains a separate conversation action. Directory favorites belong to filesystem surfaces and the directory picker.

Menu actions use concise localized verbs without repeating the conversation or working-directory context: "Reference", "Copy ID", "Open folder", "Open terminal", "Copy path", "Copy", "Pin"/"Unpin", "Stop", and "Delete". The directory section retains its target path; permission explanations and deletion confirmations stay explicit. Env App and Desktop share the same labels in every shipped locale.

Directory actions retain real icons and aligned labels. Their current labels fit one line in every shipped locale; longer future labels can wrap within the menu instead of introducing horizontal scrolling. Browser visual acceptance uses the published icons and floating layer.

## Destination behavior
Activity Files reuses its singleton window/geometry; Terminal creates a new session. Workbench creates the matching widget. Request IDs, lazy loading, terminal admission and layout persistence retain ownership. Created-thread browsing includes ThreadID; menu/terminal actions require it.

## Availability and recovery
Browsing and Terminal availability are separate. Disabled reasons/errors are explicit; rejected terminal paths cannot silently fall back to Home. Existing transport, process, authorization and persistence owners remain; Flower adds no queue, lifecycle mirror or retry owner.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body:

Use workspace-v1 only after the exact client confirms revision, path-status, directory-scope and stash-section capabilities. Buttons take their height, padding, radius and type size from the published `size` primitive: `icon` for square icon actions, `md` for ordinary text actions, `lg` where a 36px target was already intended. Do not re-impose heights on top of `size`, because the merge helper lets a passed class silently defeat the primitive and neighbours diverge. Ordinary rows use 30px, with the terminal navigator retaining its documented 32px rows. Coarse pointers use 44px rows/targets, 14px body and at least 16px fields; focus changes only the existing border color.

Published group spacing comes from role tokens. Measure real published components after fonts load, recording source/package identity, font, root, DPR and zoom. sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## One display rule
Without a successful result, retain initial presentation until authoritative data or an actionable error arrives. Mutation, attachment, maintenance and plugin execution progress remain separate from inventory loading.

## Stable geometry and retained state

Pending reads must not insert temporary rows above successful content. Use the existing action/header indicator, an accessible status outside normal flow, or a local overlay that does not alter geometry. Preserve successful same-resource lists/forms during refresh, including a successfully empty result. Equal returned items retain DOM identity, keyboard focus, expansion and scroll. Pagination keeps progress at the list end.

Initial reads use structural placeholders inside the final content region. Data-dependent editors, file previews and settings dialogs keep a responsive bounded body viewport; headers, close controls and footers stay reachable while the body scrolls. Use published Floe components and theme tokens. Do not add arbitrary delays or height animations to disguise changes.

Retention is scoped to authoritative runtime/resource/source identity. Navigation, source replacement and access loss invalidate the relevant retained state and fence late responses. Retained forms cannot submit before readiness/permission checks succeed. Keep unsaved drafts across same-resource rereads without applying stale responses to a different target. Unknown runtime status is pending, never evidence that installation is missing.

Canvas opening has a separate pending state from library initialization; keep the selected library card mounted until the canvas arrives. A file-preview request owns its path: on failure show that path with retry in the same viewport, never the previous file as the requested result. Real mutation progress, permission failures and actionable errors remain explicit.

## Page ownership
- Host Applications, Web Services, Containers and Codespaces: shared frames/list skeletons; [resource cache](env-resource-cache.md) owns snapshots, refresh and fencing.
- Files: real workspace chrome with blank regions until its first valid directory; the directory owner rejects stale responses.
- Terminal/Monitoring: shared status until catalog/first live sample or error; later attachment/polling preserves content. Metrics are not inventory snapshots.
- Settings, Flower, Tessiven, Plugin Center and dynamic plugin pages: shared module status; existing resources/runtime/lifecycle owners govern operational readiness and errors.

## Activity and Workbench
`ENV_PAGE_PRESENTATIONS` in `EnvPageLoading` exhaustively covers `BuiltinActivityPage`. New built-ins must declare loading and reload policy. [Filesystem navigation](filesystem-picker-navigation.md) retains its security boundary.

## Management placement and input
Only Plugin Center explicitly selects global Dialog placement at the product modal layer. Recent Dock or widget interactions cannot mount the drawer under `.workbench-surface`, `inert`, or a transformed canvas ancestor.

A successful Open closes management and focuses the target after canvas input becomes available; a failed Open preserves the directory and error feedback.

## Directory and responsive details
Local filters combine source (official catalog or external), trust, and lifecycle without rebuilding identity. Refresh status remains outside the card grid, so a pending refresh cannot appear as a duplicate card.

External installation source tabs retain three columns with the same complete accessible names when their visible selection labels need ellipsis.

## Shared design language

The directory, detail actions, package-install source form and update review compose released Floe controls. Cards use the shared default plane, without visible resting contours, decorative lift, icon magnification or custom shadow stacks. Selected cards use the shared selection fill. Shared Tags carry trust/lifecycle semantics without changing Host authority.

Floe owns Input focus, Button pending/disabled treatment and Tabs keyboard/selection behavior. Search, source/trust/lifecycle filters, retained selection and scroll remain product state. Menu triggers are single focusable boundaries with centered content, neutral hover and visible keyboard focus; nested trigger boxes are avoided. Details keep primary actions outside their scroll body, with secondary evidence in quiet disclosures.

Source tabs retain complete accessible names and three equal columns on compact dialogs. Mobile actions remain at least 44px; install progress replaces the primary action without changing card/sibling geometry. Reduced-motion, localized long copy and light/dark themes use the same shared controls.

## Restore saved data

Installed plugin details expose Restore saved data in the existing action menu. Discovery is read-only, including for enabled plugins. The user selects a retained record by date and instance suffix; Disable and continue is explicit when needed, and the Host then produces the exact review. A short confirmation states that current data is also retained. No permanent card, technical hash wall or automatic re-enable is added.

The dialog binds requests to the current session owner, target instance and read/write/admin permissions. Ordinary inventory refreshes preserve the review. Closing aborts reads; reopening the same target retains an uncertain plan and only checks status. Uncertain disabling likewise refreshes authoritative inventory without repeating the write. A completed recovery stays complete if list refresh fails. Source selection uses native keyboard-operable radio inputs; the existing Dialog owns isolation, dismissal and focus restoration, and mobile actions retain at least 44-pixel targets.

Admins choose compatible public HTTPS, GitHub Release/optional tag or local .redevplugin. Failed post-install refresh offers inventory Retry only, never second install.

sections.body:
## Discovery and pinning
Activity Bar Plugins opens a Shell-root Launcher without changing surface. Search intersects category with NFKC/locale-folded names, canonical keywords and explicit locale aliases. Tablet/desktop details overlay without grid reflow and restore row focus.

Tiles have one launch action, no pin overlay/indicator. Right-click/ContextMenu/Shift+F10 exposes information and current-mode Activity Bar/Workbench Dock pinning. Pinning keeps Launcher open; dismiss restores tile focus. Plugin Center provides explicit touch pins with 44px compact targets; cards/details and Activity headers also expose Activity pinning.

All entries use existing environment-scoped Shell placement preferences. Activity/Workbench pins are independent; selected state/accessibility update together. Pins never launch/enable/authorize. Unpinning an Activity page first completes its exact retirement; failed close retains pin/error. Windows/siblings retain their lifetimes.

## Recovery, installation and policy
Authenticated session-ready calls idempotent Host recoverEnabled without timers. All placements consume action_state; trust/grants/policy/recovery flags cannot derive can_open. [Installation](plugin-installation-progress.md) owns durable Execution/approved setup; [package review](plugin-package-review.md) owns external packages. Failure preserves placement.

Plugin Center joins inventory/grants/Host requirements/policy. Method effects cannot rename capabilities. Failure reloads authority and requires new confirmation.

## Activity pages/windows
Each placement allocates its fresh PluginSurfaceSlot only when both the placement and document are visible. Unopened hidden placements retain layout without an iframe or application authority; closing them succeeds without an open/revoke round trip. Once opening starts, hiding preserves the independent slot, draft, selection, undo and pending operations. All simultaneously visible placements may open concurrently. Each actual open captures the current context revision; later changes are delivered once. Each window opens through openSurfaceInSlot. Opening/bridge failures replace iframe with local recovery; timeout offers Retry. Restart restores shortcuts but opens a built-in page, never third-party content.

Equivalent metadata preserves an existing page's container/iframe/state. Visibility uses slot lifecycle; instance/surface/management-revision/runtime-generation changes retire its lease. Authority cannot survive merely for continuity. Cold open immediately shows one themed accessible waiting surface without rotating bootstrap labels; ready replaces it, failure retains recovery/details.

Each pinned page owns a stable component function. Inventory/pins may update names/icons/order without remounting siblings or discarding edits. Published Floe retained views own sibling isolation/stable DOM order: moving an identical iframe can reload its document. Acceptance checks inner document/draft as well as container; never copy another keep-alive stack.

## Workbench and teardown
[Layout continuity](plugin-layout-continuity.md) owns bindings/atomic placement/exact removal/recovery. Status overlays cannot forward input, guess focus or create bridges. Workbench unpin removes only shortcut.

One abort-aware FIFO dialog handles confirmations independently with initial Cancel focus. Hidden/retired/revoked surfaces cannot approve queued work. Retired surfaces cannot download; Shell never uploads/retains export bytes.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Navigation and visual hierarchy
Destinations are Config File, Connection, Runtime Status, Shell & Workspace, Codespaces & Tooling, Logging, Permission Policy, Flower and Debug Console. Page-owned geometry avoids competing global/lazy styles. Full padded diagnostic summaries toggle native disclosure with neutral hover and visible keyboard focus.

## Codespaces and Browser Editor
The breadcrumb owns the visible destination label. The content has one Browser Editor heading, one status badge and one inventory refresh action. The settings installation surface omits its standalone heading and refresh control; initial setup shows the selected installation route and one primary action without an idle progress checklist or empty current-editor rows. Active setup shows the current stage once, measured progress, cancellation and diagnostics; errors retain explicit retry and failure details. Runtime permissions and install/update confirmations remain authoritative.

A ready editor has a compact version/source row with the update action. Installed versions and installation paths use keyboard-accessible disclosures; selection, removal confirmation and copying stay available. Port fields show their values directly, including disabled defaults. The effective range is explained only when normalization changes custom input; autosave and its flat API payload remain unchanged. Floe tokens set field heights, corners and text; setup actions wrap and progress adapts within narrow settings surfaces.

## Settings controls and identity
Runtime, Desktop environment, Flower, terminal and managed-service fields share the published Floe control height (32px, `--floe-control-height-md`), `--floe-radius-field` corners, 12px text, quiet fill and subdued 1px border. Row identity icons and provider brands occupy the same 32px square on `--floe-radius-md`, so icon, field and select edges stay concentric within a row. Floe owns keyboard, validation, menus and border-only focus. Scalar labels need no decorative icons.

## Configuration editing
Existing autosave/restart rules govern shell, filesystem, logging, ports and permissions. Settings PUT accepts flat fields, never response-group wrappers such as `runtime`/`logging`/`codespaces`. Health, diagnostics, backup/restore use right-column actions without bypassing permission/confirmation.

## Flower extension placement
[Flower extensions](flower-extensions.md) own Skills/MCP browsing and management.

concepts.title: Shared surface material
concepts.summary: Published Floe owns material and motion. Env App/Welcome select soft-neumorphic roles while business content stays flat. Preserve input, portals, widget identity and hot interaction ownership. Resolve conflicts at the product override source without copying shadow logic or introducing another theme/dependency owner.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Configuration and ownership
Both first-party renderers set `theme.defaultSurfaceStyle` to `soft-neumorphic`. The [published dependency contract](../architecture/env-app-upstream-web-dependencies.md) owns exact package versions and registry requirements.

## Activity icon states
Published Floe owns the 24-unit rounded rail family, 1.5-unit strokes, 13% idle faces and filled selected silhouettes. Desktop Activity Bar and mobile tabs pass their real active or expanded state; hover changes ink without selecting. Monitoring remains a rounded pulse with a soft area and Switch Environment keeps slender opposing arrows. Web Services remains a globe. Plugin launcher disclosure fills while open without changing the selected page; environment switching is momentary.

Redeven's adapters consume the published icons subpath. Flower reuses the product's canonical five-petal artwork: each petal meets beneath the yellow center. Its navigation variant follows the host's size and active state, with outlined idle petals and selected ink-filled petals separated by visible surface-colored seams. Geometry remains stable through selection; ordinary brand and Workbench artwork retain their existing treatment. Shared icon detail masks reveal each theme's actual surface, and forced colors use system navigation ink. Verify live selection, disclosure, mobile editor retention, petal-seam contrast and icon contrast; never replace these with static SVG-only checks.

## Product presentation
Ordinary shared Buttons, Cards, Radio, Checkbox, Switch, Tabs, progress controls, Dialogs, and FloatingWindows use their released component treatment. Hover must preserve the selected fill and text.

The plugin launcher keeps its existing action and localized name; artwork owns no input or navigation behavior.

## Flower composer and disclosures
The expanded composer consumes Floe field fill and edge with one stable writing boundary. Chat focus transfers between editor, toolbar, menus and threads do not recolor the frame; internal controls retain keyboard focus feedback. The attachment action is the leftmost toolbar control and uses the published Plus icon. Permission selection remains compact text and a mode icon without a border, background or shadow, including hover/open states; keyboard focus underlines its label. Dedicated pages preserve the top editing inset and use equal 8px side/bottom insets for the upload and send controls. Control size derives the outer radius, keeping the send circle concentric with the lower-right corner, including the 1px border; chat, approval and input requests retain that frame, and touch controls retain 44px targets. Compact companions retain Floe panel radius, their existing height and editor identity. Floating model, permission, reasoning, More, reference, command, Goal, context and conversation controls consume published material and presence. Exiting panels become inert and hidden from accessibility immediately, while Floe finishes the visual exit; reopening reverses that exit. Context menus retain their deliberate first-frame appearance.

Model and permission menus have one surface-owned lifetime, independent of inline/More toolbar placement. Published anchored layers own positioning and boundary clamping for model, permission, reasoning and More; animated children do not own geometry. Constraints are applied before first-paint measurement, so permission menus never appear below their final position and jump upward. Published Floe also resolves the actual opening side before presence begins: menus above the composer rise from its edge and return toward it when closing; boundary flips reverse travel and transform origin together. Reduced-motion mode suppresses travel. Redeven does not override shared popup motion. Read-only, approval-required and full-access modes use the published Eye, ShieldCheck and Unlock icons consistently in the trigger, menu and toolbar measurement copy. Moving an open control into More retains its editor and focus. The More trigger is reactive so rebuilding the responsive toolbar updates the existing popup anchor before focus restoration. Hover context disclosures retain their content, scroll and expansion while hidden, with shared presence controlling paint.

Unavailable catalog models remain configured choices. A background availability update must not replace the composer with first-time setup or discard its draft, menu search or focus; unavailable models remain disabled for admission.

Cached Activity pages retain their last visible transcript gutter and toolbar allocation while hidden. Restoring a page must not resize the composer for a zero-width hidden measurement; saved thread-rail width is applied before the first visible layout.

Floeterm retains canonical cells, cursor and session grid. Font presentation cannot replace terminal authority or erase stored preferences.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## One font resolver for every terminal surface
Activity, Workbench, container exec, and settings previews consume the same font catalog and resolution result.

The menu separates bundled fonts from available local fonts and exposes the saved selection through accessible pressed state; an unavailable saved selection remains visible but cannot be newly selected.

No fallback changes a persisted preference.

## Preferences and shared terminal geometry
Activity preferences stay on the client. Unknown saved IDs are retained and resolved through the same visible fallback; no protocol or storage-field migration is introduced.

Existing clipping and navigation apply when the canonical grid does not fit the local viewport.

## Settings presentation
Terminal settings start with the actual resolved font and current theme preview. Narrow galleries retain one readable card column, including at 320px and 200% zoom.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Stores and authority
Open versioned apps/terminal/groups.sqlite and views.sqlite before readiness; future/wrong-kind/drifted state stays unchanged. Atomically reorder full non-Default list; Default stays zero.

View thumbnail opens layout picker, name activates; footer targets active view, row picker may change inactive view.2–32 slot choices preserve members/vacancies/selection. Thumbnails omit visible labels but keep accessible names/keyboard.

Views: terminal_view_catalog v3; RPC2024–2027 list/put/delete/notify,2028 atomic batch, process-launch/access-gate protected. Store ID/name/published SplitWorkspace geometry/occupancy/revision/timestamps. Pane empty:true means vacancy, no session claim. Limits64 views/32 panes/depth16/64KiB layout/128-byte IDs/64-character names. Validate shape/unique nodes/axis/ratio. Check touched views/catalog revision atomically; reject duplicate ownership/stale transfer. Cross-view transfer writes both and emits one snapshot; view deletion preserves PTYs.

Contiguous v1→v2 keeps session in highest-revision view, then newest creation, then lexical ID; prune older duplicate leaves/empty aliases without modifying sessions. v2→v3 validates existing records unchanged and enables vacancies. Close atomically replaces owned slot with fresh vacancy identity, retains geometry and emits catalog before closure event. Invalid stores remain untouched.

## Projection and UI
Navigation calls collection Groups. Icon-only plus matches Views with New group tooltip/name; scoped New session in {group} remains. Editors call default path Startup directory; membership never implies cwd.

One provider owns membership/order. Sessions/groups/views wait for current-channel Shell access and process permission, not transport/cache alone. Restored access hydrates; retirement fences replies and retains presentation. Late replies cannot undo moves/deletes; unknown groups refresh without reassignment. Deletion closes/hides members first; failures name sessions without guessed success/retry.

Search groups/paths/session presentation, temporarily reveal folded matches; views search names. Sidebar defaults258px, persists per environment/panel220–480px and reserves space. Floe ResizeHandle owns drag; arrows/Home/End keyboard; overlays have independent width.

Search/refresh replaces Quick switch. Desktop rows32px, larger mobile targets. Yellow Floe folder/disclosure/create/actions; rounded fill-selected session tiles, no rail. No view/group count badges; paths tooltip, secondary actions menu. Close visible hover/focus/touch; desktop24px actions/compact gap/indent, empty activity no title width. Reveal without title shift.

Rows/icons drag separately from buttons. Session preview follows scaled Workbench pointer; group preview stays sidebar. Split changes placement, group target membership/order. Metadata never remounts Runtime.

The data-only bridge reports loading, rendered, failure, or an immutable object selection; iOS validates the canvas, version and referenced objects before opening native details or Flower.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Layout and routing
Automatic layout and library thumbnails use the same published Floe layout engine, direction, layers, and visibility projection. Saved positions guide ordering within a layer and never override its rank. Positioned objects without relationships still contribute their actual world bounds, so fitting a newly mapped or isolated node keeps it inside the viewport.

## Connection scopes
Default browsing shows one directed overview connector per root endpoint pair. Group-internal relationships remain in the canonical pool overview and never create a group self-loop.

The interactive overview and library thumbnails always paint the root overview, even while the main canvas shows a focused host's detailed paths.

## Controls and rendering
- Canvas controls expand or collapse all logical groups in one compact reflow. They preserve the selected visible object, or its enclosing group when hidden,   and never create a document version. Large-graph   qualification measures actual host counts, including groups of ten   so a thousand-host fixture never silently measures only aggregate cards.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Reading surface
The window uses the theme's main reading surface continuously across its titlebar, transcript and composer surroundings. A subtle border and shadow frame compact readable message spacing; canvas nodes must not bleed through reply text.

End padding keeps the final choice fully readable when scrolled to the bottom; the action controls remain outside the fade.

## Actions and continuity
Less frequent actions live in the More menu: new conversation, settings, subagents, available Computer actions and opening the full conversation.

Messages, tool disclosures, questions, approvals and errors remain canonical.

Existing canvases open the combined window directly.

It never attaches to an existing user browser or Runtime.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Mechanism
Initialization, persisted restoration, permission correction, automatic open and recovery use synchronous canonical commitment such as `commitNow()`. Genuinely blocking operations keep their dedicated presentation.

## Activity and retained content
Activity uses Shell UI-first mode and after-paint activation. Files preserves hidden virtual-grid measurements, usable width/range/scroll. Flower keeps the previous transcript during cold selection and replaces it only when the latest destination is ready.

## Measurement
Debug Console groups presentation events by surface/source. User interactions must avoid renderer tasks/frame gaps of 50 ms or more. Instrumentation flags intent at 32 ms and content at 100 ms; focused performance/browser gates enforce distributions and long-task limits.

Explicit environment replacement, permission-root replacement, connection recovery, resource-pressure policy already owned by the relevant subsystem, and user-requested closure may establish separate lifecycle boundaries; a navigation click alone may not.

## Placement and state ownership
Environment recovery mounts outside the Workbench canvas and its transformed widgets.

The document never receives Runtime credentials or user draft contents.

Status styling is never injected into third-party application documents.

## Visual and accessibility behavior
Use the published `window-status.css` slots and browser-neutral `window-status` artwork entry.

Published shimmer supports reduced motion and forced colors; long translated copy and technical details must remain readable without horizontal scrolling.

A whole-window layout must not become a shared fallback for components that can be moved onto a canvas.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Surfaces and tools
Published matte palettes own canvas/widget/header/selection colors across themes. Product adapters add no competing palette, preview or drag engine; adjacent-node changes retain responsive action geometry.

The published dark canvas uses a 0.21 OKLCH lightness floor. Porcelain Dark
renders #181819 around the retained #0C0C0D product body, including overview
zoom. Widget headers, borders, shadows, grid and light canvases retain their
existing palette and geometry.

## Editing
Pristine runtimes receive one English welcome canvas: two editable notes beside Files, Terminal and Monitoring in three unnamed regions. Existing layouts, including intentionally empty advanced revisions, never reseed. Published controls own placeholders; locale changes update copy.

## Persistence
`workbench_layout_runtime` schema v6 appends sticky-note title through contiguous 5→6 migration. Handlers use current schema; material equality changes trigger persistence.

## Mechanism
Wheel ownership uses exported local scroll viewport props that set `data-floe-canvas-wheel-interactive="true"` and a local-scroll role. Text selection surfaces use separate marker props and do not receive wheel ownership unless combined with local scroll viewport props.

Fit and actual-size actions reset the scale deterministically, while Ctrl/Cmd-wheel and keyboard `+`, `-`, `0`, and `1` remain scoped to the image viewport.

Components embedded in projected Workbench surfaces must use the shared floating layer rather than hand-rolling viewport-to-surface coordinates.

[Page loading](page-loading-continuity.md) supplies per-widget Suspense/initial presentation without suspending the canvas. sections.title: Boundaries

concepts.title: Workbench terminal interaction
concepts.summary: Floeterm terminal-go owns PTY, VT, geometry, controller epoch, semantic history and atomic Presentation. terminal-web renders one canvas/view and collects local input. Authority/renderer faults fail closed; history/search faults stay local and retryable without disconnecting output.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body:
## Ownership
One SessionActor owns each session; sequence/geometry generation only advance. All views receive the same canonical-dimension Presentation. Paint complete background before cells/graphics/selection/cursor to prevent stale resize/activation/theme edges. Floeterm owns attachment/geometry arbitration; browser views never parse bytes, own history or hide extra renderers.

[Activity companion](flower-activity-companion.md#activity-terminal-footer) owns its measured footer; Workbench supplies none. Layout grants no attachment/control/input authority. TerminalInputBridge sends confirmed Unicode once, structured keys to native encoder and bounded paste. Reject script/malformed URLs, stale capabilities and remote paths.

Clear is actor semantic reset, never canvas erasure/Ctrl-L/recreation/detach. Stale generations do nothing. Close/delete removes catalog/attachments/capabilities; late events cannot resurrect sessions.

## History
Published HistoryScrollbar owns capture, frame-coalesced navigation, minimum thumb, cursors, track paging and Arrow/Page/Home/End. Redeven adds a 16 CSS-pixel rail, localized name/focus style and input focus restoration. History controller alone owns offset; cancel/capture-loss/blur/disposal release dragging.

Accepted text/paste/pressed or repeated keys return live through Floeterm input-follow by default; release-only, preedit, selection/copy, modifiers/background output do not. Persisted terminal:follow_input can disable it across Activity/Workbench/container surfaces. Return clears search/errors/stale retry/trace; old replies cannot restore browsing.

Settings separate new-session Runtime defaults from explicit current-session apply. Blank uses native defaults; zero grants no history budget. Rows and bytes (MiB display) jointly constrain page-granular storage, excluding live screen; neither means character count/screen dimensions. Only admins save defaults. Current-session apply needs interaction permission and confirmation for irreversible pruning; process/live screen/canonical geometry remain.

Fence reads/confirmation to selected session. Late defaults save refreshes visible defaults after selection changes. Unknown mutation blocks changes until explicit read-only reload, never replay. Old runtimes show unavailable; all shipped locales cover labels/feedback/confirmation.

## Product state
Dormant sessions are metadata-only; catalog has no renderer. Ask Flower reads selection or bounded visible semantic text; cwd requires current local-path capability. Canonical active/running/idle state and saved activity indicators remain authoritative. Opaque bodies/neutral static shadows stay unchanged during activation/drag/resize.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.body: Redeven adapts Flowersec transport, permissions, local paths, responsive placement, notifications and Desktop URL/file actions. Never duplicate parsing/key encoding/history/arbitration/geometry/frame/cursor/graphics/rendering. No sibling links, raw-byte fallbacks, hidden renderers, resize reattach, swallowed errors or sequence rollback.
